questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: 'hospital' 的中文含义是'图书馆'。
questions.explanation: hospital是医院，library才是图书馆。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: How do you come to school? I come ___ bus.
questions.explanation: “by + 交通工具”表示出行方式，因此说 by bus。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: The yellow light means '___'.
questions.explanation: 黄灯表示等待。看到黄灯时应停下并等待安全通行。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: My home is near. I go to school ___.
questions.explanation: near 表示“近”，步行去学校符合句意；on foot 意为“步行”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: ___ do you go to the park? By bike.
questions.explanation: 询问交通方式用How，答语By bike表示“骑自行车”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: I ___ go by bus because it's cheap.
questions.explanation: often 是频度副词，表示“经常”。句意是“我经常乘公共汽车，因为它很便宜”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: Please ___ at a red light.
questions.explanation: 红灯时应该停下来，stop at a red light 表示“在红灯处停车/停下”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: Slow down and stop ___ a yellow light.
questions.explanation: 表示在信号灯处停下，常用固定搭配 stop at a light。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: Tell ___ about your school.
questions.explanation: tell后面接人作宾语，应用人称代词宾格me。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: Don't ___ on the road. It's dangerous.
questions.explanation: 句意是“不要在马路上奔跑，那很危险”。Don't 后接动词原形，故选 run。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: How ___ your father go to work?
questions.explanation: How 引导的特殊疑问句中，your father 是第三人称单数，询问一般现在时的行为要用 does；does 后的 go 用原形。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: 单词 taxi 的中文意思是什么？
questions.explanation: taxi 的意思是“出租车”；sled 是“雪橇”，ferry 是“轮渡”，subway 是“地铁”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.knowledge: 交通工具及出行方式表达
questions.stem: “乘火车”可以说“by train”。
questions.explanation: “by train”表示乘火车，是正确搭配。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.knowledge: 频度副词在出行习惯中的应用
questions.stem: I ___ walk to school. 我经常步行上学。
questions.explanation: 句意是“我经常步行上学”。often表示“经常”，放在行为动词walk前。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.knowledge: 频度副词在出行习惯中的应用
questions.stem: 判断正误：I go usually to school by bike.
questions.explanation: 表示频率的usually通常放在行为动词go之前，正确语序是“I usually go to school by bike.”

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.knowledge: 频度副词在出行习惯中的应用
questions.stem: 选出最合适的词：I ride my bike to school on most school days. I ___ ride my bike to school.
questions.explanation: usually表示“通常”，说明大多数时候骑车上学，符合句意。频度副词放在行为动词ride之前。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: When the pedestrian signal says “WALK,” you may cross after checking that it is safe.
questions.explanation: “Walk”信号亮起时，行人可以按规则过街，但仍应先观察车辆，确认安全。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: 'by bike' 的意思是'骑自行车'。
questions.explanation: by bike 表示“骑自行车”或“乘自行车”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: 行人信号显示“Walk”时，行人可以在确认安全后过马路。
questions.explanation: “Walk”表示行人可以在确认安全后通行；过马路时仍要留意车辆。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: 选出语法正确的句子。
questions.explanation: 主语 She 是第三人称单数，一般现在时中谓语动词 like 要加 -s，变为 likes。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: “We visit the zoo yesterday.” 是语法正确的句子。
questions.explanation: yesterday 表示过去，句子应使用一般过去时：We visited the zoo yesterday.

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: 选出语法正确的句子。
questions.explanation: now 表示正在发生的动作，使用现在进行时；结构为主语 + be 动词 + 动词-ing。主语 They 对应 are，play 变为 playing。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: 'zoo' 的中文含义是'动物园'。
questions.explanation: zoo的意思是动物园，人们可以在那里观看动物。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: I like listening ___ music after school.
questions.explanation: “listen to”是固定搭配，表示“听……”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: Please look ___ the picture.
questions.explanation: “look at”表示“看……”，是常见固定搭配。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: We often play football ___ Sunday.
questions.explanation: 星期前通常用介词 on，因此“在星期天”是 on Sunday。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: Amy is good ___ drawing pictures.
questions.explanation: “be good at”表示“擅长……”，介词 at 后的动词要用 -ing 形式。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: My brother was born ___ 2016.
questions.explanation: 年份前通常用介词 in，因此说 in 2026。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: What should you do at a red light?
questions.explanation: 红灯亮时要停下。Stop at a red light 意为“红灯停”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: We should cross the road at a ___.
questions.explanation: 斑马线的英语是 zebra crossing。过马路时应走斑马线。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: A green light means “Stop.”
questions.explanation: 绿灯表示可以在确认安全后通行，不是红灯。红灯时应停下。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: In winter, it is often very ___. The opposite of “hot” is “___.”
questions.explanation: hot 表示“热”，cold 表示“冷”，两者意思相反。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: Please ___ the blackboard. The teacher is writing on it.
questions.explanation: look at 强调“看”这个动作，后面通常接看的对象；这里要看黑板。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: I didn’t eat lunch. Now I feel ___.
questions.explanation: 句子说午饭还没吃，说明“饿了”；thirsty 表示“渴了”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: Amy rides her bicycle to the park. She goes there ___.
questions.explanation: 句中说明她骑自行车去公园，表达交通方式用 by bike。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: You can borrow books from a ___.
questions.explanation: library 是“图书馆”，人们可以在那里借书；hospital 是“医院”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: ___ you like English? Yes, I do.
questions.explanation: 主语you的一般现在时一般疑问句用助动词Do开头。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: ___ is your brother? He is in the library.
questions.explanation: 答语in the library表示地点，询问地点用Where。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: ___ cooks dinner at home? My mother does.
questions.explanation: 答语My mother说明询问的是人物，因此用Who。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: ___ do you get up? At seven o’clock.
questions.explanation: 答语At seven o’clock说明时间，询问时间用When。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: We ___ have lunch at school.
questions.explanation: usually 表示“通常”，放在实义动词 have 之前。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: My sister ___ kind to her friends.
questions.explanation: 含有 be 动词的句子中，频度副词通常放在 be 动词之后，所以应说“My sister is always kind.”

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: He is ___ late for school. He always arrives on time.
questions.explanation: never 表示“从不”。句意是“他从不迟到”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: I ___ watch a movie at weekends.
questions.explanation: sometimes 表示“有时”，表示动作并非总是发生。句意是“我有时在周末看电影”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: I ___ at seven every morning.
questions.explanation: get up 是“起床”的意思，句意是“我每天早上七点起床”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: Tom can’t find his bag. He is ___ it.
questions.explanation: look for 表示“寻找”。句意是“他正在找他的书包”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: It’s time to go to bed. Please ___ the light.
questions.explanation: turn off 表示“关掉”。关灯时可以说 Turn off the light.，也可以说 Turn the light off.

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: My sister ___ her little dog every day.
questions.explanation: look after 表示“照顾、照看”，句意是“姐姐每天照看她的小狗”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: It is cold outside. Please ___ before you go out.（put on your coat）
questions.explanation: put on 表示“穿上”。宾语是代词 it 时，要放在 put 和 on 之间，因此说 put it on。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: Please look ___ my little brother while I am out.
questions.explanation: look after 是固定搭配，意思是“照顾”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: We should listen ___ the teacher carefully.
questions.explanation: listen to 是固定搭配，意思是“听……”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: Tom is good ___ drawing pictures.
questions.explanation: be good at 是固定搭配，表示“擅长……”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: The children are waiting ___ the bus.
questions.explanation: wait for 是固定搭配，意思是“等待……”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: We get ___ the bus at the next stop.
questions.explanation: get on the bus 是常见搭配，表示“上公共汽车”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: ___ is my sister.
questions.explanation: 句子缺少主语，主语位置用人称代词主格she。句首字母大写。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: Tom is looking for ___ pencil.
questions.explanation: 空格后有名词“pencil”，表示“他的铅笔”，名词前用形容词性物主代词his。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: This bike is ___.
questions.explanation: 空格后没有名词，表示“这辆自行车是我们的”，应使用名词性物主代词ours。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: I often play football with ___.
questions.explanation: 介词“with”后接宾语，且指代复数的人，使用宾格them。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: I made the cake by ___.
questions.explanation: 主语I和宾语指同一个人时，宾语用反身代词myself，意为“我自己”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: Tom ___ reading storybooks.（like）
questions.explanation: Tom 是第三人称单数主语。一般现在时肯定句中，实义动词 like 要加 -s。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: The students ___ in the classroom.（be）
questions.explanation: 主语 The students 是复数，be 动词要用 are。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: My sister ___ watch TV on school nights.
questions.explanation: 主语 My sister 是第三人称单数，否定句用 doesn't；doesn't 后的动词用原形 watch。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: “apple”是什么意思？
questions.explanation: Apple 的意思是“苹果”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: 单词 Monday 的中文意思是什么？
questions.explanation: Monday 的意思是“星期一”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: teacher 的中文意思是什么？
questions.explanation: teacher 的意思是“老师”；doctor 是“医生”，farmer 是“农民”，nurse 是“护士”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: “library”是什么意思？
questions.explanation: library 的意思是“图书馆”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: “cloudy”是什么意思？
questions.explanation: cloudy 的意思是“多云的”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: 判断正误：“Be quiet.” 的意思是“安静些”。
questions.explanation: “Be quiet.” 是祈使句，意思是“安静些”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: 选择合适的疑问词填空：_____ do you live?
questions.explanation: 询问地点用 Where。句子结构是“Where + do + you + live?”

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: 选择正确的句子。
options: How do I can help you?
questions.explanation: 有情态动词 can 时，将 can 放在主语 I 前，构成“疑问词 + can + 主语 + 动词原形 + 其他？”

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: 选择正确的肯定句。
options: We must pay attention to the traffic lights.
Must we pay attention to the traffic lights.
We must pays attention to the traffic lights.
We pay must attention to the traffic lights.
questions.answer: We must pay attention to the traffic lights.
questions.explanation: 肯定句按“主语 + 情态动词 + 动词原形 + 其他成分”排列。We 是主语，must 后接动词原形 pay，完整表达为 pay attention to the traffic lights。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: 选择语序正确的肯定句。
questions.explanation: They 是主语，play 是谓语，football 是动作对象，after school 补充时间。肯定句按“主语 + 谓语 + 其他成分”排列。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: 判断正误：She likes music. 是一个肯定句。
questions.explanation: 主语是第三人称单数 She，一般现在时的行为动词要加 -s，因此 She likes music. 是正确的肯定句。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: 'fast' 的反义词是 'slow'。
questions.explanation: fast快, slow慢。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: We can go to the moon by subway.
questions.explanation: 去月球不能乘地铁。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: In China, people drive on the right side.
questions.explanation: 中国交通规则是靠右行驶。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: 'Straight' 的意思是 '向左转'。
questions.explanation: straight是直着走，turn left才是左转。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: Alaska is very cold, so children go to school by sled.
questions.explanation: 阿拉斯加寒冷多雪，课文提到那里乘雪橇上学。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: How ___ you come to school?
questions.explanation: 主语you用助动词do。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: Usually I come ___ foot.
questions.explanation: 固定搭配on foot。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: I ___ go by bike, but sometimes I walk.
questions.explanation: 根据句意表通常的频率。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: The park is over there. Let's ___ the street.
questions.explanation: cross the street横穿马路。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: Slow down and ___ at a yellow light.
questions.explanation: 黄灯要减速并停下。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: ___ see a doctor if you feel ill.
questions.explanation: Go see a doctor是祈使句建议。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: The hospital is far from here. You can take the ___.
questions.explanation: 距离远选交通工具subway。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: ___ she often go to the library by bus?
questions.explanation: 单三疑问句用Does引导。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: Robin ___ many ways to go to school.
questions.explanation: 主语Robin人称单三，动词用knows。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: Stop at ___ red light.
questions.explanation: 固定表达at a red light。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: 'tomorrow' 的意思是'昨天'。
questions.explanation: tomorrow 的意思是“明天”，yesterday 才是“昨天”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: 'take a trip' 的意思是“去探险”。
questions.explanation: take a trip 的意思是“去旅行”，不是“去探险”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: 句子“I am going to see a film”中，be going to 表示打算做某事。
questions.explanation: be going to + 动词原形可以表示未来的计划或打算。句中 I am going to see a film 表示“我打算去看电影”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: 'Where' 常用于询问地点。
questions.explanation: Where 用于询问地点，例如：Where is my bag?（我的包在哪里？）

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: 'post office' 是'邮局'的意思。
questions.explanation: post office 是固定词组，意思是“邮局”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: Which word means “漫画书”?
questions.explanation: comic book 意为“漫画书”；dictionary 是“词典”，postcard 是“明信片”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: What ______ you going to do this evening?
questions.explanation: 主语是 you，be 动词用 are。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: Sarah is going to ______ her grandparents tonight.
questions.explanation: be going to 后面跟动词原形，所以用 visit。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: I'm going to buy a dictionary in the ______.
questions.explanation: 买字典通常要去书店，bookstore 意为“书店”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: — ______ are you going? — This afternoon.
questions.explanation: 答句“This afternoon.”表示时间，询问时间用When。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: We are going to ______ a film tonight.
questions.explanation: see a film 是固定搭配，表示“看电影”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: I'm going to take a trip ______ week.
questions.explanation: next week表示“下周”，是将来的时间状语，与be going to表示将来的计划相符。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: I want to send a ______ to my friend.
questions.explanation: send a postcard意为“寄一张明信片”，postcard是可以寄给朋友的物品。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: Have a good time! — ______.
questions.explanation: 当别人祝你玩得愉快时，应表示感谢，回答“Thank you”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: — ______ are you going to the cinema? — By bus.
questions.explanation: 答句“By bus.”表示交通方式，询问方式用How。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.knowledge: 计划相关的活动词汇与时间状语
questions.stem: 判断正误：We plan go camping tomorrow.
questions.explanation: plan 后要接 to 再接动词原形，正确说法是 We plan to go camping tomorrow.

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: 'last Sunday' 表示将来的时间。
questions.explanation: last Sunday 表示“上个星期日”，属于过去的时间状语；tomorrow 才表示“明天”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: Which word means “词典”?
questions.explanation: dictionary 意为“词典”，可用来查找单词的意思。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: 'comic book' 的意思是“漫画书”。
questions.explanation: comic book 的意思是“漫画书”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: 'Who' 常用于询问人物。
questions.explanation: Who 用来询问人物，句意是“谁是你的英语老师？”

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: 'go to school' 的意思是“去上学”。
questions.explanation: go to school 是常见搭配，意思是“去上学”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: I ______ a student.
questions.explanation: 主语是 I，be 动词用 am。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: She ______ my sister.
questions.explanation: 主语是 she，属于第三人称单数，be 动词用 is。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: They ______ in the classroom.
questions.explanation: 主语是 they，表示复数，be 动词用 are。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: It ______ a sunny day.
questions.explanation: it 是第三人称单数，be 动词用 is。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: You ______ my good friends.
questions.explanation: you 表示“你”或“你们”时，be 动词都用 are。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: Tom usually ______ basketball after school.
questions.explanation: 句子描述每天的习惯，用一般现在时；主语 Tom 是第三人称单数，play 要加 -s。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: We ______ to the park yesterday.
questions.explanation: yesterday 表示过去，go 的过去式是不规则变化 went。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: My cat ______ fish every morning.
questions.explanation: 一般现在时中，主语 My cat 是第三人称单数，eat 要加 -s。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: We can borrow books from the ______.
questions.explanation: 我们去图书馆借书。borrow 意为“借入、借阅”，library 意为“图书馆”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: Let's go to the ______ to see a film.
questions.explanation: 看电影通常去电影院。cinema 意为“电影院”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: If you are ill, you can see a doctor in the ______.
questions.explanation: 生病了通常要去医院看医生。hospital 意为“医院”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: Amy wants to send a letter. She should go to the ______.
questions.explanation: 寄信要去邮局。post office 意为“邮局”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: We can see many old things in a ______.
questions.explanation: 参观古老的物品可以去博物馆。museum 意为“博物馆”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: — ______ do you read books after school? — At the school library.
questions.explanation: 答句“At the school library.”表示地点，询问地点用Where。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: — ______ is that girl? — She is my cousin.
questions.explanation: 答句“My cousin.”表示人物，询问人物用Who。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: — ______ is in your schoolbag? — A storybook.
questions.explanation: 答句“A storybook.”表示物品，询问是什么用What。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: — ______ does Ben go to school? — By bike.
questions.explanation: 答句“By bike.”表示上学的方式，询问方式用How。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: I usually ______ my homework after dinner.
questions.explanation: do homework 是固定搭配，表示“做作业”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: Please ______ the music carefully.
questions.explanation: listen to music 是固定搭配。listen 表示主动听，后面接宾语时通常要加 to。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: We ______ breakfast at seven every morning.
questions.explanation: have breakfast 是固定搭配，表示“吃早饭”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: The children often ______ basketball after school.
questions.explanation: play basketball 是固定搭配，表示“打篮球”。球类运动前通常不加冠词。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: May I ______ a photo of the flowers?
questions.explanation: take a photo 是固定搭配，表示“拍照”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: 选出时间状语和动词形式搭配正确的句子。
options: I go to the park yesterday.
I went to the park yesterday.
I will go to the park yesterday.
I am going to the park yesterday.
questions.answer: I went to the park yesterday.
questions.explanation: “Yesterday”表示“昨天”，说明动作发生在过去，因此应使用一般过去时“went”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: ______ I will visit my grandma.
questions.explanation: tomorrow表示“明天”，是将来的时间状语。句子表示明天将去看望奶奶，因此用will visit。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: We saw a big dog three days ______.
questions.explanation: 表示“……以前”时，ago放在时间词后面，因此应说 three days ago。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: ______ I walk to school with my sister.
questions.explanation: Every day表示“每天”，说明经常发生或习惯性的动作；主语I与动词原形walk搭配正确。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: It is raining. I need an ______.
questions.explanation: 下雨时可以用umbrella（雨伞）遮雨。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: I don't know this word. I can look it up in a ______.
questions.explanation: dictionary意为“词典”，可以用来查找单词的意思。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: We take photos with a ______.
questions.explanation: camera意为“照相机”，可以用来拍照。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: I need a ______ to get on the train.
questions.explanation: ticket意为“票”，乘坐火车时通常需要车票。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: Thank you for your help. — ______.
questions.explanation: 别人说“Thank you”表示感谢，常用“You're welcome”回应，意为“不客气”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: I'm sorry I'm late. — ______.
questions.explanation: 别人说“I'm sorry”表示道歉，可以用“That's OK”表示没关系。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: 你早上遇见老师，可以说：______.
questions.explanation: 早上见面时，可以用“Good morning”互相问候。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: Can you help me carry this box? — ______.
questions.explanation: 对方请求帮忙时，如果愿意帮助，可以回答“Sure”，表示“当然可以”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: Would you like to play football with us? — ______.
questions.explanation: 接受邀请时，可以说“Yes, I'd love to”，表示“好的，我很乐意”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: “Tomorrow” means “昨天”。
questions.explanation: tomorrow 的意思是“明天”，不是“昨天”；“昨天”是 yesterday。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: 判断正误：take a trip 的意思是“去旅行”。
questions.explanation: take a trip 是常见表达，意思是“去旅行”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: next week 的意思是“下周”。
questions.explanation: next week 中 next 表示“下一个”，所以 next week 是“下周”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: 'dictionary' 的中文意思是词典。
questions.explanation: dictionary解为字典、词典。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: 动词 visit 后面不能直接接地点或人。
questions.explanation: visit可以直接接宾语，如visit my aunt, visit Beijing。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: 我们通常晚上(evening)去看电影(see a film)。
questions.explanation: 语境逻辑成立。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1

questions.explanation: a 是修饰单数，books是复数，不能连用。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: 表示计划打算做某事，只能用 will，不能用 be going to。
questions.explanation: 在小学阶段，be going to 是表示计划最核心的结构。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: I'm going to ______ computer lessons next week.
questions.explanation: be going to 后面必须使用动词原形。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: What's the meaning of 'half price'?
questions.explanation: half 是二分之一，price是价格。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: Can I help you? — ______.
questions.explanation: 商店或服务性用语的礼貌回答。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: Why ______ you going to the library?
questions.explanation: 根据 going 判断前面的 be 动词应搭配 you，故用 are。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: If you want to read books, you should go to the ______.
questions.explanation: 读书要往图书馆。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: ______ is your father going to the park? — At 9 o'clock.
questions.explanation: 提问具体的时间点（几点钟）应用 What time。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: I want to ______ my teacher.
questions.explanation: 探望某人常用visit。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: We are going to meet ______ 2 p.m.
questions.explanation: 具体时间点前用介词 at。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: I have ______ today. I'm going to relax at home.
questions.explanation: 根据在家休息推断是没有计划。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: My sister and I ______ going to the cinema.
questions.explanation: 主语是二人，复数，用 are。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Upper)
questions.stem: 'reading stories' 的中文意思是“阅读故事”。
questions.explanation: reading stories 意为“阅读故事”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Upper)
questions.stem: 'climbing mountains' 的中文意思是“钓鱼”。
questions.explanation: climbing mountains 意为“爬山”；“钓鱼”是 fishing。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Upper)
questions.stem: 在句子 'He likes singing.' 中，likes 是动词 like 的三单形式。
questions.explanation: 主语 He 是第三人称单数。在一般现在时中，动词 like 要加 -s，变成 likes。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Upper)
questions.stem: 询问对方的爱好，可以说 “What is your hobby?”。
questions.explanation: What is your hobby? 是以 what 开头的特殊疑问句，用来询问对方的爱好。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Upper)
questions.stem: 'singing' 是 'sing' 的 -ing 形式。
questions.explanation: singing 是 sing 加 -ing 构成的形式。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Upper)
questions.stem: I like ________ English words.
questions.explanation: like 后接动词-ing形式表示喜欢做某事，因此 study 要变为 studying。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Upper)
questions.stem: Oliver likes ________ kung fu.
questions.explanation: 表达“练功夫”常用 do kung fu。like 后描述活动时通常接动词-ing形式，因此用 doing。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Upper)
questions.stem: He ________ in Australia.
questions.explanation: 主语 He 是第三人称单数，一般现在时中行为动词 live 要加 -s，变为 lives。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Upper)
questions.stem: —_______ are Peter's hobbies? —He likes reading.
questions.explanation: 询问爱好是什么，用疑问代词 what。句意是：“彼得的爱好是什么？”

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Upper)
questions.stem: 选取“笔友”的正确英文表达。
questions.explanation: pen pal 意为“笔友”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Upper)
questions.stem: —Does he live on a farm? —No, ________.
questions.explanation: Does 开头的一般疑问句，否定回答用 No, 主语 + doesn't。此处主语是 he。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Upper)
questions.stem: My sister likes ________.
questions.explanation: 表达喜欢唱歌时，like 后用动词-ing形式：like singing。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Upper)
questions.stem: She ________ Chinese to her students.
questions.explanation: 主语 She 是第三人称单数；teach 以 ch 结尾，一般现在时变为 teaches。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Upper)
questions.stem: Which phrase means “集邮”?
questions.explanation: collecting stamps 意为“集邮”，是表示爱好的常见短语。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Upper)
questions.stem: —________ does he live? —He lives in Canberra.
questions.explanation: 询问地点用 Where。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Upper)
questions.stem: “flying kites”是什么意思？
questions.explanation: “flying kites”的意思是“放风筝”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Upper)
questions.stem: “write an email”是什么意思？
questions.explanation: write an email 的意思是“写邮件”。go hiking 是“去远足”，climb mountains 是“爬山”，watch TV 是“看电视”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Upper)
questions.stem: 判断正误：She likes dancing. 表示“她喜欢跳舞。”
questions.explanation: 介绍第三人称单数的爱好时，like 要加-s，因此 She likes dancing. 正确。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Upper)
questions.knowledge: 一般现在时第三人称单数陈述
questions.stem: 判断正误：He like apples.
questions.explanation: 句子的主语是 He，属于第三人称单数；普通动词 like 要加 -s，正确句子是 He likes apples.。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Upper)
questions.knowledge: 询问他人信息的特殊疑问句
questions.stem: “When does he get up?”可以用来询问“他什么时候起床吗？”
questions.explanation: 询问某人什么时候起床，用When开头；主语是he，一般现在时借助does，后接动词原形get up。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Upper)
questions.stem: 选择正确的形式填空：I like ______.（我喜欢跳舞。）
questions.explanation: like 后接动词-ing 形式。dance 变为 dancing 时去掉词尾不发音的 e，因此完整句子是 “I like dancing.”

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Upper)
questions.stem: 判断句子是否正确：The dogs is hungry.
questions.explanation: “The dogs”是复数主语，应搭配 are。原句应改为 “The dogs are hungry.”

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Upper)
questions.stem: Mia likes ________ chess after school.
questions.explanation: play chess 表示“下棋”；like 后描述活动时用动词-ing形式，所以填 playing。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Upper)
questions.stem: I often ________ swimming on Sundays.
questions.explanation: go swimming 是“去游泳”的常见表达。句子主语是 I，因此用 go。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Upper)
questions.stem: “She likes singing.”的意思是“她喜欢唱歌”。
questions.explanation: singing 的意思是“唱歌”，所以“She likes singing.”表示“她喜欢唱歌”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Upper)
questions.stem: 选择正确的句子。
questions.explanation: 主语 Lily 是第三人称单数，动词 study 以辅音字母加 y 结尾，要把 y 改为 i 再加 -es，写作 studies。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Upper)
questions.stem: My brother ________ TV after dinner.
questions.explanation: 主语 My brother 是第三人称单数；watch 以 -ch 结尾，通常加 -es，变为 watches。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Upper)
questions.stem: Emma ________ coffee.
questions.explanation: 主语 Emma 是第三人称单数，否定句使用 doesn’t + 动词原形，因此填 doesn’t like，不能写 doesn’t likes。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Upper)
questions.stem: The dog ________ a long tail.
questions.explanation: 主语 The dog 是第三人称单数；have 的第三人称单数形式是不规则变化 has。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Upper)
questions.stem: 选择正确的一般疑问句。
options: Does Tom walks to school every day?
Does Tom walk to school every day?
Do Tom walk to school every day?
Is Tom walk to school every day?
questions.answer: Does Tom walk to school every day?
questions.explanation: 一般现在时的一般疑问句中，第三人称单数使用 Does 开头；助动词后面的行为动词用原形 walk。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Upper)
questions.stem: _______ is your English teacher?
questions.explanation: 询问人的身份用 who。句意是：“谁是你的英语老师？”

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Upper)
questions.stem: _______ is this schoolbag?
questions.explanation: 询问物品属于谁，用 whose。句意是：“这是谁的书包？”

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Upper)
questions.stem: _______ is your book, the red one or the blue one?
questions.explanation: 句中给出了两本书这一选择范围，因此用 which 询问“哪一本”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Upper)
questions.stem: 判断正误： “He walks to school every day.” 可以翻译为“他每天步行去学校。”
questions.explanation: 句子表达的是“他每天步行去学校。”逐词理解后，再按自然的中文语序表达即可。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Upper)
questions.stem: ______ Anna go to school by bus?
questions.explanation: 当句子用 does 提问时，后面的实义动词要用原形，因此应说 Does Anna go，而不是 Does Anna goes。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Upper)
questions.stem: They ________ English at school.
questions.explanation: 主语 They 不是第三人称单数，一般现在时中使用动词原形 study。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Upper)
questions.stem: The bird ________ in the sky.
questions.explanation: 主语 The bird 是第三人称单数。fly 以辅音字母加 y 结尾，变 y 为 i 再加 -es，成为 flies。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Upper)
questions.stem: ________ your father like apples?
questions.explanation: 主语 your father 是第三人称单数，疑问句用 Does 开头；助动词后面的动词用原形 like。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Upper)
questions.stem: Lily ________ eat meat.
questions.explanation: 主语 Lily 是第三人称单数，否定句用 doesn’t；doesn’t 后接动词原形 eat。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Upper)
questions.stem: —________ do you play basketball? —On Sunday.
questions.explanation: 答语“On Sunday”表示时间，因此用 When 询问“什么时候”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Upper)
questions.stem: —________ is that girl? —She is my sister.
questions.explanation: 答语“my sister”指人物，因此用 Who 询问“谁”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Upper)
questions.stem: —________ are you going to bed early? —Because I am tired.
questions.explanation: 答语说明了原因（因为我累了），所以用 Why 询问“为什么”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Upper)
questions.stem: “cooking food”的意思是“烹饪食物”。
questions.explanation: “cooking food”表示烹饪食物，也就是做饭。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Upper)
questions.stem: 判断正误：Climb mountains 的意思是“爬山”。
questions.explanation: climb mountains 的意思是“爬山”，所以这个句子说法正确。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Upper)
questions.stem: 句子 'Does he likes dancing?' 在语法上是正确的。
questions.explanation: 有助动词 does 时，实义动词必须用原形，应为 Does he like dancing?

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Upper)
questions.stem: 'farm' 的意思是'公园'。
questions.explanation: farm 意思是农场，公园是 park。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Upper)
questions.stem: 'teach' 的三单形式是 'teaches'。
questions.explanation: 以 ch 结尾的动词加 es。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Upper)
questions.stem: We are both interested in music. 意思是我们都对音乐感兴趣。
questions.explanation: be interested in 表示对...感兴趣，both 表示两者都。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Upper)
questions.stem: 名词用 his 还是 her 取决于人称性别。
questions.explanation: his 他的，her 她的。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Upper)
questions.stem: Mary ________ to the music every morning.
questions.explanation: Mary 是三单，且 every morning 表示经常性，用一般现在时。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Upper)
questions.stem: My pen pal ________ like doing word puzzles.
questions.explanation: 三单主语的否定句借用 doesn't。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Upper)
questions.stem: John ________ in the city.
questions.explanation: study 变三单，去 y 变 i 加 es。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Upper)
questions.stem: The boy likes ________ kites.
questions.explanation: 制作风筝是 make kites，在 like 后用 making。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Upper)
questions.stem: —________ she go home by bike? —Yes, she ________.
questions.explanation: 主语 she 对应助动词 Does。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Upper)
questions.stem: I have a pen pal. He ________ from the UK.
questions.explanation: He is from... 或 He comes from...。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Upper)
questions.stem: What are ________ hobbies?
questions.explanation: hobbies 是名词，前接形容词性物主代词 your。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Upper)
questions.stem: He like reading ________.
questions.explanation: 本单元高频词 comic books (漫画书)。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Upper)
questions.stem: Identify the WRONG sentence.
questions.explanation: like 后面应该接 v-ing，应为 dancing。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Upper)
questions.stem: I like ________ comics.
questions.explanation: 看书/看漫画通常用 read。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Volume 1)
questions.stem: 'pilot' 的意思是“飞行员”。
questions.explanation: pilot意为“飞行员”，指驾驶飞机的人。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Volume 1)
questions.stem: A worker usually works in a hospital.
questions.explanation: 工人通常在工厂（factory）工作；医生或护士通常在医院（hospital）工作。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Volume 1)
questions.stem: 在询问职业时，'What do he do?' 是正确的表达方式。
questions.explanation: 主语是he，询问职业时要用does，后面的动词用原形。正确表达是“What does he do?”

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Volume 1)
questions.stem: If you like sports, you can be a head teacher.
questions.explanation: 喜欢运动的人可能更适合成为运动员（athlete）或体育老师（PE teacher）。head teacher是校长，和喜欢运动没有直接的对应关系。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Volume 1)
questions.stem: 'by bike' 意为“骑自行车”。
questions.explanation: by + 交通工具表示乘坐或使用某种交通方式；by bike 意为“骑自行车”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Volume 1)
questions.stem: What ______ your father do?
questions.explanation: your father 是第三人称单数。一般现在时的特殊疑问句使用 does，后面的 do 用原形。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Volume 1)
questions.stem: He works in a post office. He is a ______.
questions.explanation: 在邮局（post office）工作的人通常是邮递员（postman）。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Volume 1)
questions.stem: My aunt works ______ a university.
questions.explanation: work at a university 是常见搭配，表示“在一所大学工作”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Volume 1)
questions.stem: A ______ helps sick people.
questions.explanation: 医生（doctor）帮助生病的人。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Volume 1)
questions.stem: — ______ does he work? — He works in a gym.
questions.explanation: 对地点提问用疑问词 Where，意思是“哪里”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Volume 1)
questions.stem: My mother is a ______ . She can sing many songs.
questions.explanation: 会唱歌的人是歌手，sing（唱歌）加上表示“做某事的人”的 -er，构成 singer。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Volume 1)
questions.stem: She ______ to work by bus.
questions.explanation: 主语 She 是第三人称单数，一般现在时谓语动词 go 要加 -es，变为 goes。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Volume 1)
questions.stem: If you like drawing, you can be an ______.
questions.explanation: drawing 意为“画画”，喜欢画画的人可以成为艺术家，artist 符合句意。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Volume 1)
questions.stem: — ______ does she go to work? — By car.
questions.explanation: 答语 By car 表示交通方式，询问“怎样去上班”用 How。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Volume 1)
questions.stem: I want to be a ______ because I like science.
questions.explanation: 喜欢科学（science）对应的理想职业是科学家（scientist）。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Volume 1)
questions.stem: Which sentence correctly matches a job with its work?
options: A police officer helps people and keeps them safe.
A post office helps people and keeps them safe.
questions.answer: A police officer helps people and keeps them safe.
questions.explanation: “Police officer”是“警察”的意思，警察帮助人们并保护他们的安全。其他选项分别是“邮递员”“校长”和“邮局”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Volume 1)
questions.knowledge: 职业名词与工作场所对应
questions.stem: A teacher usually works in a school.
questions.explanation: Teacher 是“教师”，school 是“学校”，教师通常在学校工作。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Volume 1)
questions.knowledge: 职业及通勤方式的询问
questions.stem: “How does he go to work? — He goes to work on foot.” 这组问答表达正确吗？
questions.explanation: 询问某人如何上班可以说“How does he go to work?”；回答步行时用“on foot”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Volume 1)
questions.knowledge: 职业规划与个人兴趣的逻辑关联
questions.stem: Maya says, “I enjoy helping sick people, so I’d like to be a doctor.” Her interest is connected to her job choice.
questions.explanation: 句子说明了 Maya 喜欢帮助别人，而医生的工作包括照顾病人，因此兴趣和职业内容有关联。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Volume 1)
questions.knowledge: 职业规划与个人兴趣的逻辑关联
questions.stem: Amy enjoys reading stories and making up her own stories. Which sentence best explains her career choice?
options: A. I enjoy reading stories, so I’d like to be a writer.
B. I enjoy reading stories, so I’d like to be a swimmer.
C. I enjoy reading stories, so I’d like to be a driver.
D. I enjoy reading stories, so I’d like to be a gardener.
questions.answer: A. I enjoy reading stories, so I’d like to be a writer.
questions.explanation: A 说明了阅读故事的兴趣与写故事的职业之间的联系。其他选项没有清楚解释这种兴趣如何与职业相关。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Volume 1)
questions.stem: A cook usually works in a restaurant.
questions.explanation: 厨师通常在餐馆（restaurant）工作，因此句子正确。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Volume 1)
questions.stem: If you like helping sick people, you can be a ______.
questions.explanation: 医生可以帮助病人，喜欢帮助和照顾别人的人可能适合成为医生。句子中的doctor以辅音音素开头，因此使用a。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Volume 1)
questions.stem: If you like singing, you can be a singer.
questions.explanation: 喜欢唱歌的人可能适合成为歌手（singer）。爱好可以作为选择职业的参考。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Volume 1)
questions.stem: Which job may suit someone who likes painting?
questions.explanation: 喜欢画画的人可能适合成为艺术家。artist以元音音素开头，所以前面用an；teacher以辅音音素开头，前面用a。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Volume 1)
questions.stem: She ______ reading storybooks.
questions.explanation: She 是第三人称单数，肯定句中的一般现在时实义动词 like 要加 -s。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Volume 1)
questions.stem: They ______ football after school.
questions.explanation: 主语 They 是复数，肯定句中一般现在时的实义动词用原形 play。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Volume 1)
questions.stem: Tom ______ watch TV on school nights.
questions.explanation: Tom 是第三人称单数，否定句使用 doesn't；助动词后面的实义动词用原形 watch。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Volume 1)
questions.stem: He ______ my best friend.
questions.explanation: 主语 He 是第三人称单数，be 动词应使用 is。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Volume 1)
questions.stem: ______ you have a pet?
questions.explanation: 主语 you 搭配助动词 do，构成一般现在时的一般疑问句；主语后的实义动词用原形 have。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Volume 1)
questions.stem: She teaches children at school. She is a ______.
questions.explanation: 在学校教学生的人是教师（teacher）。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Volume 1)
questions.stem: He works in a hospital and helps sick people. He is a ______.
questions.explanation: 医生照顾病人并帮助他们恢复健康；句中 sick people（病人）是提示。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Volume 1)
questions.stem: My uncle drives a bus every day. He is a ______.
questions.explanation: 驾驶公交车的人是司机（driver）；句中的 drives 和 bus 提供了线索。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Volume 1)
questions.stem: He grows vegetables on a farm. He is a ______.
questions.explanation: 在农场种植庄稼或饲养动物的人是农民（farmer）。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Volume 1)
questions.stem: She makes meals in a restaurant. She is a ______.
questions.explanation: 在餐馆为顾客做饭的人是厨师（cook）；make meals（做饭）是关键词。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Volume 1)
questions.stem: Please listen ______ the teacher carefully.
questions.explanation: listen to 是固定搭配，表示“听……”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Volume 1)
questions.stem: We have an English lesson ______ Monday.
questions.explanation: 表示在具体星期几时通常用 on，因此说 on Monday。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Volume 1)
questions.stem: The film starts ______ seven o’clock.
questions.explanation: 表示具体时刻通常用 at，因此说 at seven o’clock。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Volume 1)
questions.stem: I’m waiting ______ my friend outside the library.
questions.explanation: wait for 是固定搭配，表示“等待……”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Volume 1)
questions.stem: Amy is good ______ drawing pictures.
questions.explanation: be good at 是固定搭配，表示“擅长……”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Volume 1)
questions.stem: I ______ at seven o’clock every morning.
questions.explanation: get up 意为“起床”。句子表示我每天早上七点起床。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Volume 1)
questions.stem: “They play football after school.” 意思是“他们放学后踢足球。”
questions.explanation: play football 意为“踢足球”，符合句意。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Volume 1)
questions.stem: It is cold outside. Please ______ your coat.
questions.explanation: 天气冷时需要穿上外套。put on 意为“穿上”，强调穿衣的动作。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Volume 1)
questions.stem: Lily ______ her little brother every day.
questions.explanation: look after 意为“照顾”。句意是“莉莉每天照顾她的弟弟”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Volume 1)
questions.stem: ______ do you live? — I live in Beijing.
questions.explanation: 问“你住在哪里？”用 Where。主语是 you，疑问句中用 do。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Volume 1)
questions.stem: “Where are we?”可以用来询问“我们在哪里吗？”
questions.explanation: 句子使用 Where 询问地点，且主语 we 后面使用 are，语序正确。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Volume 1)
questions.stem: We can read and borrow books in a ______.
questions.explanation: 图书馆的英文是 library，字母顺序是 l-i-b-r-a-r-y。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Volume 1)
questions.stem: We don't go to school on ______.
questions.explanation: 星期六是 Saturday，拼写时注意中间的字母组合 tur。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Volume 1)
questions.stem: The flowers are very ______. I like them.
questions.explanation: “美丽的”是 beautiful，常见拼写是 b-e-a-u-t-i-f-u-l。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Volume 1)
questions.stem: I stayed at home ______ it was rainy.
questions.explanation: because 表示“因为”，注意拼写中间是 cause，不要漏写字母 a。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Volume 1)
questions.stem: The two pictures are not the same. They are ______.
questions.explanation: different 意为“不同的”，正确拼写为 d-i-f-f-e-r-e-n-t，注意开头有两个 f。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Volume 1)
questions.stem: Tom ______ apples.
questions.explanation: Tom 是第三人称单数，一般现在时动词 like 要加 -s，变为 likes。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Volume 1)
questions.stem: They ______ football after school.
questions.explanation: They 是复数主语，一般现在时使用动词原形 play。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Volume 1)
questions.stem: The cat ______ under the table.
questions.explanation: The cat 是单数名词，be 动词要用 is。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Volume 1)
questions.stem: We ______ good friends.
questions.explanation: We 是复数人称代词，be 动词要用 are。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Volume 1)
questions.stem: My brother ______ TV in the evening.
questions.explanation: My brother 是第三人称单数；watch 以 ch 结尾，一般现在时第三人称单数形式加 -es，写作 watches。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Volume 1)
questions.stem: Mum says, “The sky gets dark after the sun goes down.” So, after the sun goes down, the sky gets dark.
questions.explanation: 妈妈说太阳下山后天会变暗。太阳下山后天变暗，符合句子给出的信息。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Volume 1)
questions.stem: — ______ do you get up? — At seven o’clock.
questions.explanation: 答语 at seven o’clock 表示时间，询问“什么时候”用 When。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Volume 1)
questions.stem: — ______ are the students reading? — In the library.
questions.explanation: 答语 In the library 表示地点，询问“在哪里”用 Where。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Volume 1)
questions.stem: — ______ is playing football? — My brother.
questions.explanation: 答语 My brother 指一个人，询问“谁”用 Who。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Volume 1)
questions.stem: — ______ do you want to go home? — Because I’m tired.
questions.explanation: 答语 Because I’m tired 说明原因，询问“为什么”用 Why。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Volume 1)
questions.stem: — ______ book is this? — It’s Tom’s.
questions.explanation: 答语 It’s Tom’s 表示物品属于汤姆，询问“谁的”用 Whose。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Volume 1)
questions.stem: I want to help sick people. I want to be a ______.
questions.explanation: doctor 是“医生”。想帮助病人，可以说：“I want to be a doctor.”

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Volume 1)
questions.stem: I want to be ______ artist.
questions.explanation: artist 以元音音素开头，因此前面用 an。完整句子是“I want to be an artist.”

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Volume 1)
questions.stem: “I want to be a teacher.” 的意思是“我想成为一名教师。”
questions.explanation: teacher 的意思是“教师”，这句话表示“我想成为一名教师”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Volume 1)
questions.stem: Choose the correct sentence.
questions.explanation: Artist 意为“艺术家”，以元音音素开头，因此前面用 an。完整句子是 She is an artist.

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Volume 1)
questions.stem: A: What does your grandfather do? B: ______
questions.explanation: What does he do? 用来询问男性的职业；farmer 意为“农民”，回答为 He is a farmer.

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Volume 1)
questions.stem: Choose the correct answer: The boys and their teacher ______ in the classroom now.
questions.explanation: The subject “The boys and their teacher” refers to more than one person, so the correct be verb is “are.” “Now” shows the sentence describes the present situation.

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Volume 1)
questions.stem: Which sentence correctly matches a job with its work?
options: A farmer takes care of sick people.
questions.explanation: Teacher（教师）教学生，因此正确句子是“A teacher teaches students.”

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Volume 1)
questions.stem: A postman delivers letters.（邮递员投递信件。）
questions.explanation: A postman（邮递员）delivers letters（投递信件），所以句子正确。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Volume 1)
questions.stem: 选择正确的词填空：What ___ they do?
questions.explanation: 主语they不是第三人称单数，询问他们的职业时用“What do they do?”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Volume 1)
questions.stem: 选择正确的词填空：What ___ Amy do?
questions.explanation: 主语Amy是第三人称单数，因此特殊疑问句中用does。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Volume 1)
questions.stem: 'coach' 这个词的意思是'主教练'。
questions.explanation: coach在体育语境下意为教练。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Volume 1)
questions.stem: We should say 'a artist' instead of 'an artist'.
questions.explanation: artist以元音音素开头，应用an。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Volume 1)
questions.stem: A fisherman works in a factory.
questions.explanation: 渔民(fisherman)通常在海上工作。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Volume 1)
questions.stem: 'What is your job?' 与 'What do you do?' 意思相近。
questions.explanation: 两者均用于询问职业。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Volume 1)
questions.stem: If you are good at writing, you can be a reporter.
questions.explanation: 记者(reporter)需要良好的写作能力。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Volume 1)
questions.stem: My uncle is a ______.
questions.explanation: 其他选项存在拼写错误。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Volume 1)
questions.stem: How ______ your mother go to work?
questions.explanation: your mother为三单，疑问句使用does。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Volume 1)
questions.stem: My aunt works at a ______. She is a scientist.
questions.explanation: 科学家通常在大学(university)或实验室工作。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Volume 1)
questions.stem: If you like swimming, you can be a ______.
questions.explanation: 逻辑关联，游泳和渔民都与水相关。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Volume 1)
questions.stem: My uncle works on a boat. ______ is a fisherman.
questions.explanation: uncle是男性，用He代指。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Volume 1)
questions.stem: — Where does he work? — ______
questions.explanation: Where问地点，回答应包含地点。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Volume 1)
questions.stem: He often ______ storybooks after school.
questions.explanation: He是第三人称单数，动词加s。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Volume 1)
questions.stem: Which of these is NOT a job?
questions.explanation: university是地点词（大学），其他是职业。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Volume 1)
questions.stem: Oliver ______ going to be a businessman.
questions.explanation: be going to结构，Oliver用is。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Book 7 (Grade 6 Volume 1)
questions.stem: I want to be a pilot. I should ______ every day.
questions.explanation: 职业理想需要努力学习(study hard)实现。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: 'angry' 这个单词的意思是'悲伤的'。
questions.explanation: angry的意思是“生气的”，表示生气的情绪；“悲伤的”是sad。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: 'afraid' 这个单词的意思是'害怕的'。
questions.explanation: afraid的意思是“害怕的”，表示感到恐惧。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: 'take a deep breath' 的意思是“深呼吸”。
questions.explanation: take a deep breath意为“深呼吸”，常用于建议别人放松或缓解紧张。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: 当别人生病时，我们可以建议说：'You should see a doctor.'
questions.explanation: see a doctor意为“看医生”。生病时建议对方看医生是恰当的表达。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: 在句子 'He should count with ten.' 中，介词 with 使用正确。
questions.explanation: 正确说法是 count to ten，表示“数到十”。count with ten 不是表达这个意思的正确搭配。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: The mouse is ______ of the cat.
questions.explanation: 句意是“老鼠害怕猫”。be afraid of 表示“害怕……”，所以填 afraid。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: —How ______ Sarah feel? —She is sad.
questions.explanation: Sarah 是第三人称单数，询问她的感受时用 does；does 后面的 feel 保持原形。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: If you are ill, you ______ see a doctor.
questions.explanation: 生病时应该去看医生，表达建议常用 should，后接动词原形 see。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: I failed the math test. I am very ______.
questions.explanation: 考试不及格通常会让人感到伤心，因此选 sad（伤心的）。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: Don't be angry. You should ______ and count to ten.
questions.explanation: 生气时深呼吸并数到十有助于平静下来，因此应选“take a deep breath”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: Sam is ______ his football.
questions.explanation: look for 意为“寻找”。句中有 is，表示现在正在做的动作，因此用现在进行时 is looking for。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: The boy is ______ because his father is ill.
questions.explanation: 爸爸生病是让人担心的原因，因此男孩感到担心（worried）。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: If you follow the rules, the teachers will be ______.
questions.explanation: 遵守规则，老师会高兴。will 后接 be，be 后可以接形容词 happy。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: The opposite word of 'sad' is ______.
questions.explanation: sad 意为“伤心的”，happy 意为“开心的”，两者意思相反。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: Your friend is going to have a big match. He is nervous. You can say: ______
questions.explanation: 朋友因比赛紧张，需要安慰。用“Don't worry.”表示“不要担心”，符合情境。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: Amy feels angry. What should she do?
options: You should take a deep breath.
You should eat some ice cream.
questions.answer: You should take a deep breath.
questions.explanation: “Feel angry”表示生气，深呼吸可以帮助人平静下来，因此应选“You should take a deep breath.”

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.knowledge: 情绪与心理状态形容词
questions.stem: “Afraid” means feeling scared. Is this statement true or false?
questions.explanation: afraid 的意思是“害怕的”，可以描述一个人的感受。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.knowledge: 情绪与心理状态形容词
questions.stem: This book is ______. I want to read a more interesting one.
questions.explanation: bored 描述人的感受，boring 描述令人无聊的事物。句中主语是 book，因此填 boring。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.knowledge: 针对负面情绪提出缓解建议
questions.stem: 判断正误：You look sad. Why not talk to your friend?
questions.explanation: “Why not”后接动词原形。“talk”用法正确，这句话是在建议对方和朋友谈谈。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.knowledge: 条件句中表达情绪调节
questions.stem: 句子“If I feel nervous, I can talk to my teacher.”表达了遇到紧张情绪时可以采取的做法。判断正误。
questions.explanation: If I feel nervous 是条件从句，主句 I can talk to my teacher 说明可以采取的调节方法。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: Which word means “担心的”？
questions.explanation: worried 的意思是“担心的”，例如：She is worried about the test.（她在担心考试。）

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: 句子 'Amy is good at playing basketball.' 中，good 后面的 at 使用正确。
questions.explanation: be good at 表示“擅长……”。后面接名词或动词-ing形式，所以 playing 符合搭配。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: Lily gets a good present. She feels ______.
questions.explanation: 收到好消息通常会感到高兴。happy 表示“高兴的”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: The dog cannot find its favorite toy. It looks ______.
questions.explanation: 小狗丢了心爱的玩具，可能会感到伤心。sad 表示“伤心的”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: Someone breaks Tom’s bike. Tom is ______.
questions.explanation: 有人弄坏了 Tom 的自行车，他可能会生气。angry 表示“生气的”；be angry with someone 表示“生某人的气”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: —______ do you feel today? —I feel happy.
questions.explanation: 询问某人的感受可以用“How do/does ... feel?”；主语 you 前用 do。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: Your friend has a cold. You say: “You ______ have a rest.”
questions.explanation: 朋友感冒了，建议他休息，可以用 should；should 后接动词原形 rest。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: We walked for a long time. I want to drink some water. I am ______.
questions.explanation: 走了很长时间后，想喝水，说明“我”口渴了。thirsty 意为“口渴的”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: The cat is ______ the table. You can see it below the table.
questions.explanation: 猫在桌子下面，under 意为“在……下面”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: Lily is taller than everyone else in her class. Lily is ______.
questions.explanation: 她比班里其他同学都高，tall 意为“高的”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: Ben has a fever, so he is ill. Here, “ill” means “sick.”
questions.explanation: 句子说 Ben has a fever（发烧了），所以他不舒服。ill 意为“生病的”，判断为正确。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: “You could talk to your friend.”可以用来给朋友提建议。
questions.explanation: “You could + 动词原形”是提出建议的常见表达；could后用动词原形talk。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: Amy ______ at seven every morning.
questions.explanation: get up 意为“起床”。主语 Amy 是第三人称单数，句子描述日常习惯，动词用 gets。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: It's dark in the room. Please ______ the light.
questions.explanation: turn on 意为“打开”，可以和表示电器的名词搭配。祈使句用动词原形。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: The children are ______ their holiday plans.
questions.explanation: talk about 意为“谈论”。句中有 are，表示正在进行的动作，因此用 are talking about。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: Choose the sentence that means “昨晚下雨了，所以地面是湿的”。
options: The ground is wet, but it did not rain last night.
The ground is wet because it rained last night.
It rained last night, but the ground is dry.
The ground will be wet if it rains tonight.
questions.answer: The ground is wet because it rained last night.
questions.explanation: “because”表示原因：昨晚下雨是原因，地面湿是结果。选项2表达了相同的因果关系。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: 选出表示“天气很冷，所以我穿上了外套”的句子。
options: It was cold, but I put on my coat.
It was cold, so I put on my coat.
It was cold because I put on my coat.
If it was cold, I put on my coat.
questions.answer: It was cold, so I put on my coat.
questions.explanation: 天气冷是原因，穿上外套是因此采取的行动。so 表示“所以”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: Tom stayed at home because it was raining. So he went to the park.（根据句意判断：他去了公园。）
questions.explanation: 句子说汤姆因为下雨而待在家里，说明他没有去公园。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: 判断正误：If it rains tomorrow, we will stay at home.
questions.explanation: 在常见的真实条件句中，if 从句通常用一般现在时，主句可以用 will 加动词原形。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: The opposite word of 'big' is ______.
questions.explanation: big 意为“大”，small 意为“小”，两者意思相反。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: The opposite word of 'hot' is ______.
questions.explanation: hot 意为“热的”，cold 意为“冷的”，两者意思相反。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: You accidentally step on your classmate's foot. You can say: ______
questions.explanation: 不小心踩到别人的脚时，应先道歉。“I'm sorry.”表示“对不起”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: Your friend says, “Let's clean the classroom together.” You agree. You can say: ______
questions.explanation: 朋友提议一起打扫教室，你赞同这个建议，可以说“Good idea.”（好主意）。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: “You are right.” can be used to agree with someone.（判断正误）
questions.explanation: “You are right.”表示“你说得对”，可以用来表示赞同。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: 判断正误：If you are ill, you should see a doctor.
questions.explanation: should后面接动词原形，句中的see是原形；生病时看医生也是合理的建议。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: 判断正误：be afraid 的意思是“害怕”。
questions.explanation: be afraid 的意思是“害怕”，不是“生气”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: If you feel thirsty, you can drink some water.
questions.explanation: 感到口渴时喝水是合适的建议。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: 选择正确的句子，询问“他感觉怎么样？”
questions.explanation: 主语 he 是第三人称单数，疑问句中用 does；does 后面的动词用原形 feel。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: 判断正误：How do you feel? 可以用来询问“你感觉怎么样？”
questions.explanation: “How do you feel?” 用来询问对方“你感觉怎么样？”，句型正确。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: 选择合适的回答：How do you feel?
questions.explanation: 回答“How do you feel?”时，可以用“I feel + 情绪或感受词”。happy 表示“开心的”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: 'wrong' 的意思是'错误的'，也可以在'What's wrong?'中表示'怎么了'。
questions.explanation: wrong可以指错误，也可以指身体或情绪不适。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: 'worried' 表示'担心的'。
questions.explanation: worried是形容词，表示忧虑或担心。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: 'do more exercise' 的意思是'做更多的练习'，只能指数学题复习。
questions.explanation: do exercise通常指体育锻炼。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: In 'They are afraid of him', 'of' is necessary.
questions.explanation: be afraid of 是固定搭配，表示害怕某人或某物。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: If you are angry, you should chase the cat.
questions.explanation: 生气时不应该追逐猫，而应该冷静。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: I am ______ because my cat is lost.
questions.explanation: 宠物丢了会感到伤心。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: How ______ your father feel today?
questions.explanation: your father是第三人称单数，用does。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: You ______ be angry. You should take a breath.
questions.explanation: 你不应该（shouldn't）生气。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: If you are ______ , you can wear more clothes.
questions.explanation: 感到冷（cold）才会多穿衣服。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: Don't sit on the grass. The ants will be ______ .
questions.explanation: 坐在草地上，蚂蚁（ants）会生气。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: —What's wrong? —______
questions.explanation: What's wrong回答不适或生病的情况。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: My father is ______ with the cat for breaking the vase.
questions.explanation: 猫打破花瓶，爸爸会生气。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: Sarah should ______ because she wants to be a faster runner.
questions.explanation: 为了跑得快，需要多锻炼。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: Tomorrow is my birthday. I am ______ !
questions.explanation: 生日快到了通常感到兴奋（excited）。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: ______ should I do if I feel sad?
questions.explanation: What should I do? 表示我该做什么？

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: 在句型“How can I get to the Fuxi Museum?”中，get to 意为“到达”。
questions.explanation: get to 是固定短语，表示“到达某地”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: 'pilot' 的意思是‘科学家’。
questions.explanation: pilot 意为飞行员，科学家是 scientist。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: 寓言故事中的 “Setting” 通常指的是故事中的角色。
questions.explanation: Setting 指故事发生的时间和地点或环境；Characters 才是故事中的角色。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: 在句子 'Check it out' 中，Check 和 it 之间通常会发生连读。
questions.explanation: Check 以辅音音素 /k/ 结尾，it 以元音音素 /ɪ/ 开头，通常可以自然连读。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: “Worried”的意思是“生气的”。
questions.explanation: Worried 是“担心的”，生气的应该是 angry。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: How ______ you feel today?
questions.explanation: 询问感觉用助动词do配合动词原形feel。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: You should ______ a deep breath and count to ten.
questions.explanation: should 是情态动词，后面接动词原形，因此选 take。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: If you want to go to the park, you can go ______ bus.
questions.explanation: by + 交通工具表示出行方式，乘公共汽车说 by bus。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: Where is the post office? It's ______ the hospital.
questions.explanation: next to 表示“在……旁边”。句意是“邮局在医院旁边”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: The Robin Hood story tells us we should ______.
questions.explanation: 罗宾汉帮助有困难的人，所以故事告诉我们要帮助他人。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: What is your father's job? He is a ______.
questions.explanation: job 表示“工作、职业”，问题是在问爸爸的职业。postman（邮递员）是职业名称，其他选项不符合句意。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: What ______ you going to do this weekend?
questions.explanation: 主语是you，be动词用are。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: He likes ______ stories and singing.
questions.explanation: like 后接表示爱好的动作时，常用动词-ing形式，因此 read 变为 reading。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: Your dog is ill. You are very ______.
questions.explanation: 宠物生病了，主人通常会感到难过，所以选 sad。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: Which sentence has a natural pause (V)?
options: Wait V for the V green light.
I want V to go V to the V cinema.
First, V go to the bookstore.
Turn V left V at the V light.
questions.answer: First, V go to the bookstore.
questions.explanation: First 是句首的顺序词，后面逗号提示稍作停顿，因此这里的停顿较自然。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.knowledge: 寓言故事要素拆解与理解
questions.stem: In the story about the Fox and the Crow, the cheese fell when the Crow opened her beak.
questions.explanation: 乌鸦一张嘴唱歌，奶酪就掉了，狐狸最终拿到了奶酪。判断寓言情节时，要关注行为带来的结果。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.knowledge: 寓言故事要素拆解与理解
questions.stem: An Ant stores food for winter, but a Grasshopper spends the summer singing and playing. When winter comes, the Grasshopper has no food. Which lesson best fits this fable?
questions.explanation: 蚂蚁提前储存食物，蚱蜢却只顾玩耍；冬天到来后，蚱蜢没有食物。因此故事强调提前准备的重要性。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: 朗读陈述句 “I like my new book.” 时，句尾通常用什么语调？
questions.explanation: 陈述句通常在句尾降调。朗读时声音自然落下，不需要把每个词都读得同样重。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: 朗读一般疑问句 “Do you have a pencil?” 时，句尾通常用什么语调？
questions.explanation: 一般疑问句通常用升调，句尾声音略微上扬，例如 “Are you ready?”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: 朗读 “Where is your school?” 时，句尾通常用什么语调？
questions.explanation: 特殊疑问句通常用降调。句子由 where 提问，句尾 “school” 通常自然落下。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: 朗读词组 “look at” 时，前词末尾的辅音和后词开头的元音自然衔接，这种现象叫什么？
questions.explanation: look 以辅音 /k/ 结尾，at 以元音 /æ/ 开头，朗读时常把两词自然衔接起来，这叫连读。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: 在常见的辅音加元音连读中，后一个词通常以什么音开头？
questions.explanation: 常见连读发生在前一个词以辅音结尾、后一个词以元音开头时。连读时单词仍然保留，只是衔接更自然。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: 判断正误：英语连读就是把相邻单词中的一个词省略不读。
questions.explanation: 连读是把相邻的音自然衔接起来，不是把单词吞掉或省略。朗读 “pick it up” 时要让词语连贯，同时仍能听出原来的单词。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: “我步行去公园”可以说“I go to the park on foot.”
questions.explanation: “步行”常说 on foot，不说 by foot。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 6 Volume 1
questions.stem: farmer 的意思是“农民”。
questions.explanation: farmer 的意思是“农民”，通常从事种植或养殖工作。

questions.subject: 英语
