questions.edition: 人教版 PEP 英语六年级下册
questions.stem: 判断正误：Tom is taller than Ben. 的意思是“汤姆比本高”。
questions.explanation: tall 的比较级是 taller；“Tom is taller than Ben.”的结构和意思都正确。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: 人教版 PEP 英语六年级下册
questions.stem: 选择合适的疑问词：____ do you live?
questions.explanation: 询问地点用 Where，句意为“你住在哪里？”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: 人教版 PEP 英语六年级下册
questions.stem: 选择合适的疑问词：____ is your name?
questions.explanation: 询问物品或事情用 What，句意为“你的名字是什么？”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: 人教版 PEP 英语六年级下册
questions.stem: 选择合适的疑问词：____ is that boy?
questions.explanation: 询问“谁”用 Who。Who is that boy? 意为“那个男孩是谁？”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: 人教版 PEP 英语六年级下册
questions.stem: 'older' 是形容词 'old' 的比较级。
questions.explanation: old以辅音结尾直接加er。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: 人教版 PEP 英语六年级下册
questions.stem: If Tom is 1.6m and Sam is 1.5m, then Sam is taller.
questions.explanation: 1.6米高于1.5米，所以应该是Tom更矮（shorter）。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: 人教版 PEP 英语六年级下册
questions.stem: 'thinner' 的原形是 'thin'，变比较级需要双写n。
questions.explanation: thin是辅-元-辅结构，需双写词尾字母。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: 人教版 PEP 英语六年级下册
questions.stem: 'What size are your shoes?' 意思是 '你的鞋子是什么颜色的？'
questions.explanation: Weat size是询问尺寸，而非颜色。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: 人教版 PEP 英语六年级下册
questions.stem: 'Your shadow gets longer when the sun goes down.' 这里的 longer 是 long 的比较级。
questions.explanation: long变比较级为longer，意为更长。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: 人教版 PEP 英语六年级下册
questions.stem: Which of the following is correct?
questions.explanation: thin需双写n，heavy需改y为i，big需双写g。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: 人教版 PEP 英语六年级下册
questions.stem: ____ is your schoolbag? - It's 3 kilograms.
questions.explanation: 单位是千克，询问重量用how heavy。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: 人教版 PEP 英语六年级下册
questions.stem: Mike is thinner than ____.
questions.explanation: than后常用人称代词宾格。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: 人教版 PEP 英语六年级下册
questions.stem: The sun goes down, our shadows are ____.
questions.explanation: 根据常识，太阳下山影子变长。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: 人教版 PEP 英语六年级下册
questions.stem: She is 2 years ____ than me.
questions.explanation: than引导比较句，使用比较级older।

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: 人教版 PEP 英语六年级下册
questions.stem: Lucy is 1.5m tall. Lily is 1.55m. Who is taller?

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: 人教版 PEP 英语六年级下册
questions.stem: Your feet are No.38. Mine are No.36. Your feet are ____.
questions.explanation: 鞋码大说明脚大。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: 人教版 PEP 英语六年级下册
questions.stem: Look! The sun is shining ____ the window.
questions.explanation: through the window 穿过窗户。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: 人教版 PEP 英语六年级下册
questions.stem: I'm 48 kilograms. You are 50 kilograms. You are 2 kilograms ____ than me.
questions.explanation: 差值+比较级+than。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: 人教版 PEP 英语六年级下册
questions.stem: Which of these words is NOT a comparative form?
questions.explanation: father是名词“父亲”，虽然以er结尾但不是形容词比较级。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: 单词 'stay' 的过去式是 'stayed'。
questions.explanation: stay 以元音字母 a 加 y 结尾，直接加 -ed，变为 stayed。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: 'last weekend' 意为“下周末”。
questions.explanation: last weekend 意为“上周末”，不是“下周末”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: 动词 'read' 的过去式拼写依然是 'read'。
questions.explanation: read 的过去式拼写仍是 read，但过去式读音与现在时不同，属于不规则变化。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: 'I cleaned my room yesterday.' 是正确的一般过去时句子。
questions.explanation: 句中yesterday表示过去，动词clean使用过去式cleaned，时态正确。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: 在句子“Did you washed your clothes?”中，washed 的使用是正确的。
questions.explanation: 助动词 did 后面必须跟动词原形，应为 wash。正确句子是“Did you wash your clothes?”

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: I _______ a film last night.
questions.explanation: “last night（昨晚）”表示过去；see a film 意为“看电影”，see 的过去式是 saw。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: —What did you do? —I ________.
questions.explanation: What did you do? 询问过去做了什么，回答中的动作也要用过去式。washed my clothes 意为“洗了我的衣服”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: Did you read a _______?
questions.explanation: read常与书、报纸或杂志搭配；magazine（杂志）符合句意。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: —_______ did you go last weekend? —I went to a park.
questions.explanation: 回答是去公园，说明询问的是地点，所以用 Where。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: Mike _______ his grandparents yesterday.
questions.explanation: yesterday 表示过去的时间，句子要用一般过去时。规则动词 visit 的过去式是 visited。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: —Did you have a cold last Monday? —________.
questions.explanation: Did 引导的一般疑问句询问过去发生的事情，肯定回答用 Yes, + 主语 + did。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: It _______ good yesterday.
questions.explanation: 句子描述过去的情况，look 要用过去式 looked。这里的 look 与形容词 good 搭配，表示“看起来很好”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: I ______ fishing last Saturday.
questions.explanation: last Saturday 表示过去的时间，go 的过去式是 went，因此应说 went fishing。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: —Was the storybook interesting? —________.
questions.explanation: storybook是单数事物，可用it代替；问句用was，肯定回答也用was。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: I stayed ________ at home.
questions.explanation: stay at home all day 表示“整天待在家里”，all day 符合句意和搭配。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.knowledge: 动词过去式的规则变化
questions.stem: 选择正确的过去式：study → ____
questions.explanation: Study以辅音字母加y结尾，变过去式时先把y改为i，再加-ed，因此是studied。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.knowledge: 动词过去式的规则变化
questions.stem: 动词play的过去式是哪一个？
questions.explanation: play以元音字母a+y结尾，不把y改成i，直接加-ed，变为played。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.knowledge: 一般过去时肯定句陈述
questions.stem: 判断正误：Lucy visited her grandma two days ago.
questions.explanation: 句中有 two days ago，表示过去；visit 的过去式是 visited，因此句子正确。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: 选出 study 的正确过去式。
questions.explanation: study 以辅音字母 d 加 y 结尾，变 y 为 i，再加 -ed，过去式是 studied。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: 'ago three days' 是“几天前”的正确表达。
questions.explanation: ago 通常放在表示时间长度的词语后面，例如 three hours ago（几小时前），不能说 ago three hours。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: 选出动词 go 的正确过去式。
questions.explanation: go 的过去式是不规则变化，写作 went，不能写成 goed。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: 'They play basketball now.' 是表示“他们现在正在打篮球”的正确句子。
questions.explanation: now表示动作正在发生，应使用现在进行时。正确句子是：They are playing basketball now。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: I often _______ TV after dinner.
questions.explanation: “看电视”通常说 watch TV；句子表示日常习惯，主语 I 后用动词原形 watch。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: Grandma will _______ us a story tonight.
questions.explanation: tell someone a story 表示“给某人讲故事”；tell 的后面可以直接接人。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: May I _______ a book from the library?
questions.explanation: borrow ... from ... 表示“向……借……”；句中说从图书馆借书，所以用 borrow。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: “Look at the picture”表示“看这张图片”。
questions.explanation: look at 表示“看着、注视某物”，因此 look at the picture 表示“看这张图片”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: I ________ my little brother after school every day.（我每天放学后照顾我的弟弟。）
questions.explanation: 句意是“我每天放学后照顾我的弟弟”。look after 意为“照顾”，符合句意。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: “I get up at seven.” 的意思是“我七点起床。”
questions.explanation: get up 意为“起床”，所以句子的说法正确。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: I use a _______ to take photos.
questions.explanation: take photos表示“拍照”，常用camera（相机）拍照。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: The children play _______ after school.
questions.explanation: play football表示“踢足球”，是常见的动词与名词搭配。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: I am thirsty. I would like _______.
questions.explanation: water通常作不可数名词，表示“一杯水”时可以说a glass of water。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: We do our _______ after dinner.
questions.explanation: do homework表示“做作业”，homework通常作不可数名词，不在前面加a，也不加复数词尾。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: I brush my _______ every morning.
questions.explanation: tooth（牙齿）的复数形式是不规则变化teeth；brush one’s teeth表示“刷牙”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: —_______ do you have English class? —On Sunday.
questions.explanation: 回答“在星期天”提供的是时间信息，询问时间用 When。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: —_______ helps you with your homework? —My sister does.
questions.explanation: 回答中的 my sister 是一个人，询问人物用 Who。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: —_______ are you happy? —Because I got a new book.
questions.explanation: because引出的是原因。询问原因用 Why。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: —_______ do you go to school? —By bus.
questions.explanation: 回答说明了去学校的交通方式，询问方式用 How。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: —_______ book is this? —It is Tom's.
questions.explanation: 回答说明书属于Tom，询问“谁的”用 Whose。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: We _______ to the park last Sunday.
questions.explanation: last Sunday 表示过去的时间；go 是不规则动词，其过去式是 went。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: Amy _______ basketball with her friends last weekend.
questions.explanation: last weekend 表示过去的时间；play 是规则动词，过去式加 -ed，写作 played。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: The children _______ sandwiches yesterday afternoon.
questions.explanation: yesterday afternoon 表示过去的时间；eat 的过去式是 ate。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: —Does Amy like apples? —________.
questions.explanation: Does 引导的一般疑问句用 does 回答。主语是 she，否定简答为 No, she doesn't。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: —Are your friends in the classroom? —________.
questions.explanation: Are 引导的问句用 are 回答；主语 they 对应 are，因此肯定回答是 Yes, they are。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: The cake _______ delicious.
questions.explanation: 主语 It 是第三人称单数，句子描述现在的情况，动词用 looks。look good 表示“看起来不错”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: Please _______ the picture on the wall.
questions.explanation: look at 表示“看、注视”，后面接看的对象。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: I can't find my pencil. I will _______ it.
questions.explanation: look for 表示“寻找”。句子说“我找我的铅笔”，所以应填 look for。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: Amy is good _______ singing.
questions.explanation: be good at 是固定搭配，表示“擅长……”。介词 at 后面的动词常用 -ing 形式。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: The boy is _______ his little sister now.
questions.explanation: look after 表示“照顾、照料”。句子描述正在进行的事情，需用 be + 动词-ing，因此填 looking after。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: I ______ my little dog after school every day.
questions.explanation: look after 意为“照顾”。句意是“我每天放学后照顾我的小狗”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: Please ______ your friend outside the classroom.
questions.explanation: wait for 意为“等待”。句意是“请在教室外等你的朋友”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: Amy is good ______ drawing.
questions.explanation: be good at 是固定搭配，意为“擅长……”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: Tom ______ his keys yesterday, but he didn't find them.
questions.explanation: look for 意为“寻找”。句子描述昨天发生的事情，因此用过去式 looked for。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: Grandma ______ the flowers in the garden.
questions.explanation: take care of 意为“照顾”，与 look after 意思相近。句意是“奶奶照顾花园里的花”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: —Thank you for helping me. —________.
questions.explanation: 别人说“Thank you”表示感谢，常用“You're welcome”回应。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: —Go straight and turn left at the school. —________?
options: How can I get to the library?
What would you like to eat?
questions.answer: How can I get to the library?
questions.explanation: 回答说明了去图书馆的路线，因此问路时可问“How can I get to the library?”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: You step on your friend's foot by accident. You should say, “________.”
questions.explanation: 不小心踩到别人的脚，应先道歉，常用“I'm sorry.”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: Your guest looks thirsty. What can you say?
questions.explanation: 看到客人渴了，礼貌地询问是否需要水，可以说“Would you like some water?”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: —How do you usually go to school? —________.
questions.explanation: 问句询问通常怎样去学校，回答应说明日常交通方式；“walk to school”表示步行上学。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: My sister can ________ our little brother.（我姐姐会照顾我们的小弟弟。）
questions.explanation: look after 表示“照顾”，符合照看弟弟的语境。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: “I learn English at school.” 中的 at school 表示“在学校”。
questions.explanation: at school 表示“在学校”，句子意思是“我在学校学习英语”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: 判断正误：saw a film 的意思是“看了一部电影”。
questions.explanation: saw a film 的意思是“看了一部电影”，其中 saw 是 see 的过去式。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.knowledge: 动词原形与过去式对应
questions.stem: 判断正误：wash 的过去式是 washed。
questions.explanation: wash 是规则动词，通常在词尾加 -ed，过去式为 washed。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: 一般过去时只能用来描述昨天发生的事。
questions.explanation: 过去时间可以是昨天、上周末、两年前等。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: 以辅音字母加y结尾的动词变过去式，要把y变i再加ed。
questions.explanation: 这是规则动词过去式的变化规则之一，如study-studied。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: 'watch TV' 和 'watch a show' 都是看节目的意思。
questions.explanation: watch在此处都作'观看'解。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: 在过去时疑问句中，实义动词必须用过去式。
questions.explanation: 助动词did出现后，实义动词恢复原形。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: I had a cold 意思是'我感冒了'。
questions.explanation: have/had a cold是患感冒的固定表达。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: He _____ his room last Sunday.
questions.explanation: 由last Sunday可知需要用过去式。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: What ______ you ______ last weekend?
questions.explanation: 疑问句结构为did+动词原形。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: I _____ it on TV yesterday.
questions.explanation: 看电视节目的习惯用语是watch TV，过去式为watched。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: Did you ______ any clothes?
questions.explanation: Did引导句子的动词原形用法。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: —How was your weekend? —________.
questions.explanation: How was... 询问情况，回答It was...

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: The film was very ______.
questions.explanation: 用来修饰film的形容词，有趣interesting最合适。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: I had a cold, ______ I stayed at home.
questions.explanation: 前后是因果关系，表示“所以”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: Did Sarah _____ a storybook last night?
questions.explanation: Did后跟原形，read的原形与过去式同形但此处取其原形。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: What did you do ______ your holiday?
questions.explanation: 在假期中常用on your holiday。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: Did you and your father go fishing? Yes, _____ did.
questions.explanation: you and your father 指代“你们”，回答用“我们”we。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Down
questions.stem: 'went' 是 'go' 的过去式形式。
questions.explanation: go 是不规则动词，过去式为 went。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Down
questions.stem: 'fell off' 的意思是‘跌落’。
questions.explanation: fell off 是 fall off 的过去式，表示“从……掉下来”或“跌落”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Down
questions.stem: 在句子“Did you went there?”中，动词使用是正确的。
questions.explanation: 一般过去时疑问句用 Did + 主语 + 动词原形。did 后应使用 go，因此应说 Did you go there?

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Down
questions.stem: 'mule' 的意思是‘大象’。
questions.explanation: mule 的意思是“骡子”；“大象”是 elephant。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Down
questions.stem: 'took pictures' 意思是‘照相’。
questions.explanation: take pictures 的意思是“照相”；其过去式是 took pictures，意思是“照了相”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Down
questions.stem: — ___ did you go? — I went to Sanya.
questions.explanation: 根据答句地点Sanya可知，提问地点用Where。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Down
questions.stem: I ___ a gift for my mother yesterday.
questions.explanation: yesterday 表示“昨天”，句子要用一般过去时。buy 是不规则动词，过去式为 bought。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Down
questions.stem: How did you go there?
questions.explanation: How did you go there? 询问过去去那里的交通方式，By plane. 表示“乘飞机”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Down
questions.stem: Which one is NOT a fruit?
questions.explanation: mule意为“骡子”，是一种动物；apple、grape和banana都是水果。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Down
questions.stem: I ___ a horse last Saturday.
questions.explanation: last Saturday 表示过去的时间，ride 的过去式是 rode。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Down
questions.stem: I hurt my foot and ___ my bike.
questions.explanation: 句中的 hurt 表示过去发生的事情，因此用 fall 的过去式 fell，短语为 fell off。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Down
questions.stem: — Did you like the food there? — ___
questions.explanation: 问句使用一般过去时助动词 Did，肯定回答可以是“Yes, I did.”，否定回答可以是“No, I didn't.”。A 使用一般现在时，不符合问句时态。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Down
questions.stem: It ___ like a lab, but it is a gym now.
questions.explanation: 过去看起来像实验室，描述的是过去的情况，所以用 look 的过去式 looked；now 表示现在是健身房。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Down
questions.stem: We went there ___ foot.
questions.explanation: 表示“步行”使用固定搭配 on foot，因此填 on。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Down
questions.stem: I ___ many pictures during my holiday.
questions.explanation: take pictures 表示“拍照”；during my holiday 指假期期间，句子讲过去的假期，所以用 take 的过去式 took。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Down
questions.stem: “took pictures”是什么意思？
questions.explanation: “took pictures”中的 took 是 take 的过去式，整个词组表示“照了相”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Down
questions.knowledge: 高频不规则动词过去式转换
questions.stem: We _____ a big bird in the tree last Sunday.
questions.explanation: see 的过去式是 saw。句中有 last Sunday，表示过去的时间。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Down
questions.knowledge: 高频不规则动词过去式转换
questions.stem: Did you _____ breakfast this morning?
questions.explanation: eat 的过去式是 ate。含有 did 的一般疑问句中，动词要用原形，所以填 eat。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Down
questions.knowledge: 高频不规则动词过去式转换
questions.stem: Tom _____ a storybook before bed last night.
questions.explanation: read 的过去式拼写与原形相同，但过去式读作 /red/。表示过去的时间时，这里填 read。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Down
questions.knowledge: 过去旅程及交通方式的询问
questions.stem: I ___ to the museum yesterday.
questions.explanation: 句子中的 yesterday 表示过去，主语是 I，因此用 go 的过去式 went。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Down
questions.knowledge: 过去旅程及交通方式的询问
questions.stem: 判断正误：询问过去的旅行方式可以说“How did they traveled to the city?”
questions.explanation: 一般过去时疑问句中，did 后面的动词要用原形，应说“How did they travel...?”，不能用 traveled。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Down
questions.knowledge: 过去发生事件的逻辑叙述
questions.stem: When we tell a story about yesterday, we usually use the simple past tense.
questions.explanation: Yesterday表示过去时间，讲述过去发生的事件时，通常使用一般过去时。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Down
questions.stem: 'fell' 和 'feel' 的意思相同。
questions.explanation: fell 是 fall 的过去式，意思是“掉落”或“跌倒”；feel 的意思是“感觉”，两者拼写和含义不同。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Down
questions.stem: 句子“She walk to school every day.”的时态和动词形式正确。
questions.explanation: 主语 She 是第三人称单数，一般现在时中动词 walk 要加 -s，应为 She walks to school every day.

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Down
questions.stem: — ___ did you visit your grandma? — Last Sunday.
questions.explanation: 答句中的“last Sunday”表示时间，询问时间用When。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Down
questions.stem: — ___ is your best friend? — Tom is.
questions.explanation: 答句中的“Tom”是人物，询问人物用Who。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Down
questions.stem: — ___ are you late? — Because the bus was slow.
questions.explanation: 答句说明了迟到的原因，询问原因用Why；回答原因常用because。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Down
questions.stem: — ___ do you go to school? — By bike.
questions.explanation: 答句描述了去学校的方式，询问方式用How。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Down
questions.stem: — ___ schoolbag is this? — It is Amy's.
questions.explanation: 答句说明书包属于Amy，询问物品归属用Whose。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Down
questions.stem: We ___ to the park last Sunday.
questions.explanation: last Sunday 表示过去的时间，句子用一般过去时。go 的过去式是 went。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Down
questions.stem: Tom ___ football with his friends yesterday.
questions.explanation: 句中有 yesterday，动词要用过去式。play 是规则动词，直接加 -ed，变成 played。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Down
questions.stem: I ___ a film with my family last night.
questions.explanation: last night 表示过去的时间，see 应使用过去式 saw。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Down
questions.stem: Lucy ___ English yesterday evening.
questions.explanation: 句子说的是昨天发生的事，要用过去式。study 以辅音字母加 y 结尾，变过去式时把 y 变成 i，再加 -ed：studied。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Down
questions.stem: They ___ lunch two hours ago.
questions.explanation: two hours ago 表示“两小时前”，要用一般过去时。eat 的过去式是 ate。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Down
questions.stem: How do you go to school?
questions.explanation: How do you go to school? 询问日常上学方式。By bike. 表示“骑自行车”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Down
questions.stem: Lily smiled and laughed at her birthday party. She was happy. 句中的happy意为“开心的”。
questions.explanation: 句子说明Lily在生日会上很开心，所以happy表示“开心的”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Down
questions.stem: Please ___ the teacher carefully.
questions.explanation: listen 后面接表示听的内容时，通常要加介词 to。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Down
questions.stem: ___ the picture on the wall, please.
questions.explanation: look at 意为“看……”，后面可以接要看的对象。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Down
questions.stem: “Wake up”可以表示“醒来”。
questions.explanation: wake up 意为“醒来；叫醒”，是常见的动词短语。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Down
questions.stem: 判断正误：They goes to the park last year.
questions.explanation: 句中 last year 表示过去，通常要用一般过去时；go 的过去式是 went，不是 goes。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Down
questions.stem: Please listen ___ the teacher.
questions.explanation: “听……”用固定搭配 listen to，所以填 to。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Down
questions.stem: Look ___ the picture on the wall.
questions.explanation: “看……”常用 look at，故填 at。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Down
questions.stem: We are waiting ___ our friend.
questions.explanation: “等待某人”用 wait for somebody，因此填 for。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Down
questions.stem: Amy is good ___ drawing.
questions.explanation: “擅长……”用 be good at，at 后接名词或动名词，因此填 at。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Down
questions.stem: Tom is interested ___ English.
questions.explanation: “对……感兴趣”用 be interested in，因此填 in。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Down
questions.stem: She ___ a glass of milk every morning.
questions.explanation: 句意是“她每天早上喝一杯牛奶”。表示“喝”用 drink；every morning 表示经常发生的习惯，主语 She 是第三人称单数，因此用 drinks。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Down
questions.stem: Please ___ the door for me.
questions.explanation: 句意是“请打开门”。表示“打开”用 open；主语 you 后用动词原形 open。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Down
questions.stem: Can I ___ a book from you?
questions.explanation: 句意是“我可以从你那里借一本书吗？”表示从别人那里借入用 borrow；lend 表示借出。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Down
questions.stem: “Feed the dog” means “喂狗”。
questions.explanation: feed the dog 表示“喂狗”，feed 的意思是“喂养”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Down
questions.stem: Choose the best answer: Where is your schoolbag?
questions.explanation: “Where”询问地点。书包在桌子上，所以正确回答是“It's on the desk.”

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Down
questions.stem: How many apples do you have? Choose the correct answer.
questions.explanation: How many询问数量，苹果的数量是five（五个），所以选项B正确。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Down
questions.stem: Read the question: “How old is your brother?” Choose the correct answer.
questions.explanation: “How old”询问年龄。弟弟十二岁，所以正确回答是 “He is twelve years old.”

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Down
questions.stem: We _____ to the park yesterday. Which word completes the sentence?
questions.explanation: go 是不规则动词，过去式是 went。句子描述昨天发生的事情，因此用 went。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Down
questions.stem: We _____ at home yesterday. Choose the correct word.
questions.explanation: be动词用于过去时要用 was 或 were。主语 We 是复数，因此用 were。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Down
questions.stem: ___ you visit your grandma yesterday?
questions.explanation: 含行为动词的一般过去时疑问句用“Did+主语+动词原形”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Down
questions.stem: ___ she at home last night?
questions.explanation: 主语she是第三人称单数，be动词过去式用was。含be动词时直接把was提前，不用did。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Down
questions.stem: 'beach' 的意思是大海。
questions.explanation: beach的意思是海滩，不是大海(sea)。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Down
questions.stem: 'hurt' 的过去式还是 'hurt'。
questions.explanation: hurt是不规则动词，原形与过去式同形。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Down
questions.stem: 一般过去时的句子中一定要有 yesterday。
questions.explanation: 不一定，last series, ago或语境也可以表示过去。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Down
questions.stem: 回答 'How was your holiday?' 可以用 'It's good.'。
questions.explanation: 问句是过去式was，答句应用It was good.

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Down
questions.stem: 'go cycling' 的意思是‘去骑自行车旅行’。
questions.explanation: 正确表达。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Down
questions.stem: What ___ you do last weekend?
questions.explanation: last weekend引导过去时疑问句，借用助动词did。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Down
questions.stem: I went there with ___ parents.
questions.explanation: 名词parents前使用形容词性物主代词my。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Down
questions.stem: Sounds great! 可译为：
questions.explanation: sound是听起来的意思。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Down
questions.stem: Sarah ___ a lab yesterday.
questions.explanation: yesterday标志过去时，规则动词加ed。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Down
questions.stem: We stayed ___ a hotel last night.
questions.explanation: 在酒店使用介词in。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Down
questions.stem: I ___ to Tianshan and ___ many pictures.
questions.explanation: 描述过去的一系列动作，全部使用过去式。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Down
questions.stem: — ___ did you see? — I saw some interesting people.
questions.explanation: 询问看见了“什么”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Down
questions.stem: go 的过去式是 went, 那 come 的过去式是 ___.
questions.explanation: come是不规则动词，过去式为came。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Down
questions.stem: Which word is correct?
questions.explanation: eat的唯一正确过去式是ate。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 6 Down
questions.stem: The Labour Day holiday was ___.
questions.explanation: 假期可以是好玩的、晴朗的或漫长的。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: 描述过去的客观存在，我们使用 There was 或 There were。
questions.explanation: 描述过去某处存在某人或某物时，There be 句型使用过去时 was 或 were。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: 'grass' 的意思是‘玻璃’。
questions.explanation: Grass 的意思是“草”或“草地”；glass 才是“玻璃”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: I could not ride a bike before. 这里的 could not 代表过去的能力。
questions.explanation: could not（couldn’t）是 can not（can’t）的过去式形式之一，表示过去没有某种能力。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: the biggest 表示“最大的”，双写了字母g。
questions.explanation: big是重读闭音节单词，末尾只有一个辅音字母g，变最高级时要双写g再加-est，写作biggest。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: ago 是描述“现在”的时间标志词。
questions.explanation: ago 意为“以前”，常用于表示过去的时间，如 two days ago（两天前）。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: There _____ no library in my school ten years ago.
questions.explanation: library 是单数名词，ten years ago 表示过去，所以用 was。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: I didn't _____ like eggs before.
questions.explanation: didn't 后面接动词原形，所以用 like。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: The sun is the ______ star in our system.
questions.explanation: hot是重读闭音节单词，变最高级时双写末尾的t再加-est；空格前已有the，因此填hottest。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: My school was small ten years ago, but now it is ______.
questions.explanation: but 表示转折，前面说学校过去很小，后面应表示现在变大了，因此选 large。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: How ______ did you change?
questions.explanation: How much 可询问程度或变化的量，句意为“你改变了多少？”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: What ______ you do last night?
questions.explanation: last night表示过去，疑问句借用助动词did。did后面的实义动词用原形do。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: Now I ______ active in class.
questions.explanation: Now表示现在；主语I与be动词am搭配。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: Who is the ______ girl in your class?
questions.explanation: 句中比较范围是班级里的所有女生，属于三者或三者以上的比较，用最高级 tallest；最高级前通常加 the。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: Before, I was short. Now, I am ______.
questions.explanation: Before 和 Now 表示前后变化；short（矮的）与 tall（高的）相对，因此现在应是 tall。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: People can see many stars in the ______ at night.
questions.explanation: 星星通常出现在天空中，sky意为“天空”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: 短语 look up 的意思是什么？
questions.explanation: look up 在这里表示“查阅、查找”，不是“看起来”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: 连词成句：(was, no, library, There)
questions.explanation: 正确语序是 There was no library.，表示“以前没有图书馆”。There was 后接单数名词 library。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.knowledge: There be 句型的时态对比
questions.stem: 选择合适的词填空：_____ a book on the desk now.
questions.explanation: 句子中的 now 表示现在；a book 是单数，所以用 There is。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.knowledge: There be 句型的时态对比
questions.stem: 选择合适的词填空：_____ three birds in the tree last Sunday.
questions.explanation: last Sunday 表示过去；three birds 是复数，所以用 There were。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.knowledge: There be 句型的时态对比
questions.stem: 选择合适的词填空：_____ some water in the bottle yesterday.
questions.explanation: yesterday 表示过去；water 是不可数名词，按单数看待，因此用 There was。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.knowledge: There be 句型的时态对比
questions.stem: 判断正误：There were two apples in the bag yesterday.
questions.explanation: two apples 是复数，yesterday 表示过去，因此 There were two apples... 正确。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.knowledge: 个人能力与爱好的对比表达
questions.stem: “Amy is good at drawing.”表示“Amy擅长画画”。
questions.explanation: be good at 后面可以接动词-ing，be good at drawing 表示“擅长画画”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.knowledge: 形容词最高级的初步感知与应用
questions.stem: “good”的最高级是“the best”。
questions.explanation: good 的最高级是不规则变化 best，常见表达是 the best。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: The blue whale is the ______ animal in the world.
questions.explanation: large以不发音的e结尾，变最高级时直接加-st，写作largest。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: Tom is the ______ player of the three.
questions.explanation: good的最高级是不规则变化best。句中有of the three，表示在三个人中比较，因此用最高级。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: every day 通常表示每天重复发生的事情，不是过去时间标志词。
questions.explanation: every day 意为“每天”，表示经常发生或重复的动作，通常提示一般现在时，不表示过去。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: There _____ some flowers in the garden now.
questions.explanation: flowers 是复数名词，句子描述现在的情况，所以用 are。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: There _____ two bridges near the village last year.
questions.explanation: two bridges 是复数，last year 表示过去，所以用 were。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: There _____ a little milk in the glass.
questions.explanation: milk 是不可数名词，句子描述现在的情况，所以用 is。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: Amy _____ playing badminton now, but she didn't like it before.
questions.explanation: 句子描述现在的喜好，主语是第三人称单数 Amy，所以 like 要加 -s。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: Tom _____ like drawing, but now he draws every day.
questions.explanation: didn't 后接动词原形。didn't use to 表示过去没有某种习惯或喜好。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: It is cold in winter, but it is ______ in summer.
questions.explanation: 句意是“夏天很热，但冬天很冷”。cold 和 hot 意思相反，符合 but 表示的转折关系。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: Lily heard the good news and felt very ______.
questions.explanation: 句意是“听到好消息后，莉莉很高兴”。happy 表示“高兴的”，符合语境。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: May I ______ a book from you?
questions.explanation: 句意是“我可以从你那里借一本书吗？”borrow 表示“向别人借入”，符合 from you 的语境；lend 表示“借出”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: The rabbit runs ______, but the turtle runs slowly.
questions.explanation: 句意是“兔子跑得快，乌龟跑得慢”。slow 表示“慢的”，fast 表示“快的”，前后形成对比。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: Please keep our classroom ______. Don't throw rubbish on the floor.
questions.explanation: 句意是“请保持教室干净，不要把垃圾扔在地上”。clean 表示“干净的”，与不要乱扔垃圾的要求相符。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: ______ did you play football yesterday? — In the park.
questions.explanation: 询问地点用 Where。一般过去时的特殊疑问句语序为疑问词 + did + 主语 + 动词原形。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: ______ do you get up? — At seven o'clock.
questions.explanation: 询问时间用 When。回答“在七点钟”说明问的是几点做某事。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: ______ are you happy? — Because I got a present.
questions.explanation: 询问原因用 Why，常用 because 引导的句子回答。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: ______ apples are there in the basket?
questions.explanation: 询问可数名词的数量用 How many，后接可数名词复数 apples。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: ______ opened the window?
questions.explanation: 句中 Who 是主语，询问“谁做了这件事”，因此直接接谓语动词，不需要再用 did。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: ______ Tom like apples?
questions.explanation: 主语Tom是第三人称单数，句子表示一般现在时，因此用does；does后面的动词用原形like。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: I ______ play computer games on school nights.
questions.explanation: 主语I在一般现在时的否定句中使用don't，后面的动词用原形play。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: ______ your parents visit the museum yesterday?
questions.explanation: yesterday表示过去，疑问句用Did开头，主语后面的实义动词用原形visit。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: She ______ watch TV before finishing her homework.
questions.explanation: 主语She是第三人称单数，一般现在时否定句用doesn't；doesn't后面接动词原形watch。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: We ______ go to the park last Sunday because it rained.
questions.explanation: last Sunday表示过去，否定句使用didn't；didn't后面的实义动词用原形go。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: Tom ______ basketball every day.
questions.explanation: every day表示经常发生的动作，用一般现在时；主语Tom是第三人称单数，play要加-s。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: We ______ to the zoo yesterday.
questions.explanation: yesterday表示过去，句子用一般过去时；go的过去式是不规则变化went。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: They ______ at home last Sunday.
questions.explanation: last Sunday表示过去；主语They是复数，be动词过去式用were。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: She ______ a big dinner last night.
questions.explanation: last night表示过去，句子用一般过去时；have的过去式是had。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: My brother usually ______ like carrots.
questions.explanation: usually表示通常发生的事情，用一般现在时；主语My brother是第三人称单数，否定句用doesn't，后面的动词保持原形like。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: My dog is ______ than your dog.
questions.explanation: 句中比较两只狗，且有 than 提示，应用比较级。big 是重读闭音节短形容词，双写末尾字母 g 再加 -er，变为 bigger。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: Tom is ______ of the three boys.
questions.explanation: 三名学生进行比较，应用最高级。tall 的最高级是 tallest，最高级前加 the。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: Lily looks ______ today than yesterday.
questions.explanation: 句意是“今天比昨天更开心”，是在两者之间比较，要用比较级。happy 以辅音字母加 y 结尾，变 y 为 i 再加 -er，写作 happier。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: This book is ______ than that one.
questions.explanation: good 的比较级是不规则变化 better。句中有 than，表示两本书之间的比较。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: I am ______ my sister. We are both 150 cm tall.
questions.explanation: 句意是“和姐姐一样高”，使用原级比较结构 as + 形容词原形 + as，因此填 as tall as。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: It is lunchtime, and I haven't eaten anything today. I am ______.
questions.explanation: 句子说午饭时间还没吃东西，因此感到饿（hungry）最符合语境。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: It is raining outside. Take your ______ before you leave.
questions.explanation: 天在下雨，出门时带伞可以挡雨，因此应选 umbrella。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: ______ I missed the bus, I was late for school.
questions.explanation: 后半句说明了迟到的原因，所以用 Because（因为）连接原因和结果。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: I put on my coat because I felt ______.
questions.explanation: 后句说穿上了外套，说明当时觉得冷，因此空格填 cold。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: I like football, ______ I can't play it well.
questions.explanation: 句意是“我喜欢足球，但我不会踢”，前后内容形成转折，因此用 but。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: We can borrow books from the ______.
questions.explanation: 在图书馆，人们可以借书或读书；library意为“图书馆”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: Brush your ______ twice a day to keep them clean.
questions.explanation: tooth意为“牙齿”，其复数形式是不规则变化teeth。many后接可数名词复数。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: I would like ______ for breakfast.
questions.explanation: 句意是“我早餐想要一杯牛奶”。milk 是不可数名词，不能直接说 a milk、two milks 或 many milk；表示“一杯牛奶”应说 a glass of milk。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: There are three ______ playing in the park.
questions.explanation: child意为“孩子”，复数形式为children；句中的three表示三个，所以要用复数。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: Look at the ______ on the wall. It tells us the time.
questions.explanation: clock意为“钟”，可以告诉人们时间；door意为“门”，bed意为“床”，window意为“窗户”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: 选择正确的词填空：You ___ ready now.
questions.explanation: 主语 You 后用 are。表示“你现在准备好了”应说 You are ready now.

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: didn't 后面可以加 liked。
questions.explanation: 助动词didn't后接动词原形。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: 'dining hall' 指的是‘图书馆’。
questions.explanation: dining hall是食堂。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: easy 的最高级形式是 easiest。
questions.explanation: 辅音字母+y结尾的形容词变最高级，去y变i加est。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: couldn't 是 could not 的缩写。
questions.explanation: 考察单词缩写规则。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: 20 years ago, there was no Internet. 这句话符合历史事实。
questions.explanation: 20年前互联网在中国尚未普及。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: There _____ no gym in late 1990s.
questions.explanation: 过去的年份用过去时。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: Which one is the _____ of all?
questions.explanation: of all表示范围，用最高级。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: We stay at home and study by ______.
questions.explanation: 借助电脑在线学习。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: I loved bread, ______ now I love rice.
questions.explanation: 前后喜好对比，用转折连词。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: My grandpa ______ play football many years ago.
questions.explanation: 表示过去没有的能力。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: There were no ______ in my old school.
questions.explanation: no后面通常接名词复数。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: I'm ______ I can't go to the party.
questions.explanation: I'm afraid 用于委婉表达。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: I looked ______ my old photos yesterday.
questions.explanation: look at 看着某物。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: Before, my mother had short hair, now she _____ long hair.
questions.explanation: now 表示现在时，主语she用has。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 6 Semester 2
questions.stem: In the race, I was not fast. I was ______.
questions.explanation: 不快即是慢。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English 6B
questions.stem: 单词“plane”“train”“taxi”都属于交通工具类词汇。
questions.explanation: plane（飞机）、train（火车）和 taxi（出租车）都是交通工具。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English 6B
questions.stem: 在单词 'eraser' 前面表示 '一个' 时，应该用 'a'。
questions.explanation: eraser 开头发元音音素，表示“一个橡皮”时用 an eraser。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English 6B
questions.stem: 'I am going to visit my uncle.' 表达的是将来打算做的事情。
questions.explanation: be going to结构表示计划或打算做某事。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English 6B
questions.stem: 'last weekend' 通常与过去式连用，不与将来时连用。
questions.explanation: last weekend 意为“上周末”，表示过去的时间，通常与一般过去时连用。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English 6B
questions.stem: 在描述事情经过时，'Finally' 通常放在段落的最开头。
questions.explanation: Finally 表示“最后”，通常用于介绍叙述中的最后一件事，而不是段落开头。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English 6B
questions.stem: I would like ____ apple and ____ milk.
questions.explanation: apple 开头发元音音素，用 an；milk 是不可数名词，表示一些牛奶时用 some。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English 6B
questions.stem: Which word doesn't belong to the others?（哪一个单词不属于同一类？）
questions.explanation: scientist（科学家）、pilot（飞行员）和 coach（教练）都是职业；summer（夏天）是季节。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English 6B
questions.stem: What ____ you going to do this evening?
questions.explanation: 第二人称you对应的be动词是are。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English 6B
questions.stem: ____, he got up. Then, he brushed his teeth.
questions.explanation: 句子接着用 Then 表示“然后”，所以空格应填表示第一步的 First。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English 6B
questions.stem: Mike likes stars. He wants to be an ____.
questions.explanation: 喜欢星星并想探索太空的人可能想成为宇航员，英文是 astronaut。astronaut 的发音以元音音素开头，所以前面用 an。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English 6B
questions.stem: Yesterday I ____ to the park. Today I ____ at home.
questions.explanation: Yesterday 表示过去，go 的过去式是 went；Today 表示现在，I 与 am 搭配。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English 6B
questions.stem: ____ comes after 'Then' in a story sequence?
questions.explanation: 叙述事情顺序时，Then之后可以用After that（之后）继续衔接。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English 6B
questions.stem: ____ are you going to the party? At 7:00.
questions.explanation: 回答“At 7:00”表示时间，所以用 When 提问。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English 6B
questions.stem: Sarah is going to ____ a magazine this afternoon.
questions.explanation: be going to 后面接动词原形，所以选 read。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English 6B
questions.stem: John: I'm going to be a teacher. Amy: ____.
questions.explanation: 约翰说自己打算成为一名老师，艾米可以表示赞赏。正确表达是“That sounds great.”，其中主语“That”搭配“sounds”；“That's sounds”重复使用了谓语形式。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English 6B
questions.stem: 讲述做三明治的步骤时，要介绍最后一步，应该选哪个词？
questions.explanation: Finally 意为“最后”，通常用于介绍一系列事情中最后发生的一步。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English 6B
questions.knowledge: 词汇逻辑分类与冠词搭配
questions.stem: I have ___ egg for breakfast. 选出恰当的冠词。
questions.explanation: Egg是单数可数名词，表示泛指时需要冠词。egg以元音音素开头，因此用an。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English 6B
questions.knowledge: 词汇逻辑分类与冠词搭配
questions.stem: Tom wears ___ uniform at school. 选出恰当的冠词。
questions.explanation: Uniform虽然以字母u开头，但开头发音是辅音音素 /j/，所以用a。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English 6B
questions.knowledge: 词汇逻辑分类与冠词搭配
questions.stem: Book and pencil belong to the same group: school things.（判断正误）
questions.explanation: Book和pencil都属于学习用品，因此可以归为同一类。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English 6B
questions.knowledge: 叙事逻辑连接词的应用
questions.stem: ___, Lily put on her coat. Then she went outside.
questions.explanation: “首先”表示叙事的第一步，因此应填 First。句首连接词后加逗号。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English 6B
questions.knowledge: 叙事逻辑连接词的应用
questions.stem: I picked up my schoolbag. ___, I went to school.
questions.explanation: “然后”表示接着发生的动作。句子先说拿起书包，接着说去学校。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English 6B
questions.knowledge: 叙事逻辑连接词的应用
questions.stem: Tom was late ___ the bus was slow.
questions.explanation: 后半句说明他迟到的原因，因此用 because，表示“因为”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English 6B
questions.knowledge: 叙事逻辑连接词的应用
questions.stem: It was raining, ___ I took an umbrella.
questions.explanation: 前半句是下雨这一原因，后半句是带伞这一结果，因此用 so，表示“所以”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English 6B
questions.knowledge: 叙事逻辑连接词的应用
questions.stem: First, we cleaned the room. Then, we washed our hands. ___, we went home.
questions.explanation: 故事中先收拾玩具、再洗手，回家是最后发生的事，所以用 Finally。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English 6B
questions.knowledge: 叙事逻辑连接词的应用
questions.stem: ___ I got home, my mother was cooking dinner.
questions.explanation: 句子表示“当我到家时，妈妈正在做晚饭”，When 引出时间背景。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English 6B
questions.knowledge: 一般将来时的计划与展望
questions.stem: 判断正误：I will helps my mother tomorrow.
questions.explanation: will后面接动词原形，所以句子中的help用法正确。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English 6B
questions.stem: Monday、Tuesday 和 Friday 都属于表示星期的词汇。
questions.explanation: Monday（星期一）、Tuesday（星期二）和 Friday（星期五）都是一周中的日子。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English 6B
questions.stem: We cleaned the room. Then, we put the books away. ____, we went out to play.
questions.explanation: Finally 表示“最后”，适合引出故事中最后发生的事情。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English 6B
questions.stem: Which word doesn't belong to the others?（哪一个单词不属于同一类？）
questions.explanation: apple、banana 和 pear 都是水果；carrot（胡萝卜）是蔬菜。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English 6B
questions.stem: Which word doesn't belong to the others?（哪一个单词不属于同一类？）
questions.explanation: bus、train 和 plane 都是交通工具；tiger（老虎）是动物。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English 6B
questions.stem: Which word doesn't belong to the others?（哪一个单词不属于同一类？）
questions.explanation: doctor、nurse 和 teacher 都是职业；hospital（医院）是地点。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English 6B
questions.stem: Which word doesn't belong to the others?（哪一个单词不属于同一类？）
questions.explanation: Monday、Friday 和 Sunday 都是星期名称；winter（冬天）是季节。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English 6B
questions.stem: Which word doesn't belong to the others?（哪一个单词不属于同一类？）
questions.explanation: run、jump 和 swim 都是活动或运动动作；sleep（睡觉）通常表示休息，不属于这组运动动作。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English 6B
questions.stem: Lily wants to help sick people. She wants to be a ____.
questions.explanation: 医生给病人看病。句中说 Lily 想帮助生病的人，因此应选 doctor。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English 6B
questions.stem: Tom grows vegetables in the field. He is a ____.
questions.explanation: 农民从事种植或养殖工作。句中提到 Tom 在田里种蔬菜，因此他是一名 farmer。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English 6B
questions.stem: A teacher teaches students.（教师教学生。）
questions.explanation: teacher 的意思是“教师”，所以这句话正确。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English 6B
questions.stem: I like apples, ____ I don't like bananas.
questions.explanation: 前后两部分意思转折：我喜欢苹果，但是我不喜欢香蕉，因此用but。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English 6B
questions.stem: Tom is happy ____ he won the game.
questions.explanation: 后半句说明他开心的原因，用because连接。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English 6B
questions.stem: It was raining, ____ we stayed at home.
questions.explanation: 前半句说明原因，后半句说明结果，用so连接，表示“所以”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English 6B
questions.stem: 在句子“I have a dog and a cat.”中，and表示“和”。
questions.explanation: and可以连接意思相近或补充说明的内容，表示“和；并且”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English 6B
questions.stem: Would you like tea ____ juice?
questions.explanation: 问对方想要茶还是果汁，是提供选择，因此用or，表示“或者”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English 6B
questions.stem: ____ do you read books? In the library.
questions.explanation: 回答“In the library”表示地点，询问地点用 Where。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English 6B
questions.stem: ____ is playing football? My brother.
questions.explanation: 回答“My brother”表示一个人，询问人物用 Who。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English 6B
questions.stem: ____ are you going to bed early? Because I am tired.
questions.explanation: 回答“Because I am tired”说明原因，询问原因用 Why。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English 6B
questions.stem: ____ do you go to school? By bus.
questions.explanation: 回答“By bus”表示交通方式，询问方式用 How。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English 6B
questions.stem: ____ bag is yours, the red one or the blue one? The blue one.
questions.explanation: 回答“The blue one”是在几个选项中作选择，询问“哪一个”用 Which。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English 6B
questions.stem: Tom is good ____ drawing pictures.
questions.explanation: be good at 是固定搭配，意为“擅长……”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English 6B
questions.stem: 在句子“We look forward to seeing you.”中，to 后面的 seeing 使用正确。
questions.explanation: look forward to 是固定搭配，其中 to 是介词，后接名词或动词-ing形式。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English 6B
questions.stem: 根据对话判断正误：Mum: It's rainy today. Take your umbrella. Ben: OK. Ben should take an umbrella.
questions.explanation: “It's rainy today”说明今天在下雨，因此带雨伞是合理的。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English 6B
questions.stem: 'an' is used before the word 'hour' because it starts with a vowel sound.
questions.explanation: hour中的h不发音，发音以元音开头，所以用an。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English 6B
questions.stem: 'I will to play football' is a correct sentence.
questions.explanation: will后面直接跟动词原形，不需要to。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English 6B
questions.stem: 'Dictionary', 'book', 'newspaper' follow the same logic as reading materials.
questions.explanation: 它们都属于阅读材料类。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English 6B
questions.stem: 'Instead' can be used to show the sequence of time in a story.
questions.explanation: instead表示替代，不是时间顺序连接词。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English 6B
questions.stem: We can use 'be going to' to talk about a dream job in the future.
questions.explanation: be going to可以用来描述未来的计划或目标。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English 6B
questions.stem: ____ you ____ free next Sunday morning?
questions.explanation: 将来时的疑问句Will + 主语 + 动词原形be。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English 6B
questions.stem: The cinema is ____ the hospital. It's next to it.
questions.explanation: 表示在...旁边用next to。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English 6B
questions.stem: I had a busy day. ____ I did my homework. Then I went to bed.
questions.explanation: 根据上下文，睡觉前做的最后一件事是作业，用Finally或后接Then构成的序列中有误，此处选Finally最符合结束感。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English 6B
questions.stem: If you want to buy some books, you can go to the ____.
questions.explanation: 买书要去书店(bookstore)。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English 6B
questions.stem: My father ____ a teacher next year.
questions.explanation: 明年(next year)用一般将来时，will后面接动词原形be。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English 6B
questions.stem: ____ are you going? To the library.
questions.explanation: 回答是地点，用Where提问。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English 6B
questions.stem: I want ____ an English teacher in the future.
questions.explanation: want to be... 想要成为...

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English 6B
questions.stem: How can I get to the Fuxing Hospital? ____
questions.explanation: 询问如何到达某地，应回答交通方式或路线。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English 6B
questions.stem: He has ____ idea for the weekend.
questions.explanation: idea以元音音素/aɪ/开头，用an。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English 6B
questions.stem: Robin is a robot. He ____ eat or sleep.
questions.explanation: 机器人不需要吃和睡，eat/sleep是动词，用doesn't助动词。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: 人教版 PEP 英语四年级下册
questions.knowledge: 学校场所词汇认读与拼写
questions.stem: 'teachers' office' 的中文意思是'教师办公室'。
questions.explanation: teachers' office 的意思是“教师办公室”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: 人教版 PEP 英语四年级下册
questions.knowledge: 字母组合er在词尾的发音规则
questions.stem: 在单词 water, tiger, computer 中，结尾的 er 发音相同。
questions.explanation: water、tiger 和 computer 的词尾 er 在常见的四年级教学发音中都读作 /ə/。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: 人教版 PEP 英语四年级下册
questions.stem: 如果要表达“在二楼”，英文应该是 “on the two floor”。
questions.explanation: 楼层要用序数词，且楼层前用 on。“在二楼”应说 on the second floor。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: 人教版 PEP 英语四年级下册
questions.knowledge: 学校场所词汇认读与拼写
questions.stem: Library 是我们可以借阅图书的地方。
questions.explanation: library 意为“图书馆”，是可以借阅图书的地方。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: 人教版 PEP 英语四年级下册
questions.knowledge: 确认场所的一般疑问句
questions.stem: Do you have a library? 的否定回答是 'No, I don't.'
questions.explanation: Do you have...? 的否定回答是 No, I don't.；如果回答者代表一个集体，也可以说 No, we don't。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: 人教版 PEP 英语四年级下册
questions.knowledge: 学校场所词汇认读与拼写
questions.stem: Where do you play football? In the ________.
questions.explanation: playground 意为“操场”，通常可以在操场上踢足球。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: 人教版 PEP 英语四年级下册
questions.stem: The computer room is ________ the second floor.
questions.explanation: 表示在某一层楼时，楼层前用介词 on。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: 人教版 PEP 英语四年级下册
questions.stem: Is ________ the computer room?
questions.explanation: this 是单数指示代词，可作 Is 后的主语，意思是“这是……吗？”

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: 人教版 PEP 英语四年级下册
questions.knowledge: 学校场所词汇认读与拼写
questions.stem: My school has many beautiful flowers in the ________.
questions.explanation: garden 意为“花园”，花园里可以种植漂亮的花。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: 人教版 PEP 英语四年级下册
questions.stem: Where's the art room? It's ________ to the gym.
questions.explanation: next to 是固定搭配，表示“紧邻、在……旁边”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: 人教版 PEP 英语四年级下册
questions.knowledge: 确认场所的一般疑问句
questions.stem: Is this the music room? Yes, ________.
questions.explanation: Is this...? 的肯定简短回答是 Yes, it is.，用 it 指代 this。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: 人教版 PEP 英语四年级下册
questions.knowledge: 学校场所词汇认读与拼写
questions.stem: Go to the ________. Read a book.
questions.explanation: library 意为“图书馆”，go to the library 表示“去图书馆”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: 人教版 PEP 英语四年级下册
questions.knowledge: 确认场所的一般疑问句
questions.stem: Do you have a music room? ________. We have one.
questions.explanation: We have one 表示“我们有一间”，所以前面的回答应为肯定形式 Yes, we do.。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: 人教版 PEP 英语四年级下册
questions.stem: That's my classroom. It's on the ________ floor.
questions.explanation: 描述楼层时要用序数词。first 是“第一”，所以说 on the first floor。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: 人教版 PEP 英语四年级下册
questions.knowledge: 学校场所词汇认读与拼写
questions.stem: How many ________ are there in your school?
questions.explanation: How many 后面接可数名词复数，因此用 students。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: 人教版 PEP 英语四年级下册
questions.knowledge: 学校场所词汇认读与拼写
questions.stem: Which place do you go to read books?（你去哪个地方读书？）
questions.explanation: library 的意思是“图书馆”，人们可以在里面读书。A 是办公室，C 是操场，D 是体育馆。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: 人教版 PEP 英语四年级下册
questions.stem: “next to”是什么意思？
questions.explanation: next to 表示“紧邻、在……旁边”，因此正确答案是 C。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: 人教版 PEP 英语四年级下册
questions.knowledge: 字母组合er在词尾的发音规则
questions.stem: sister 和 teacher 中，词尾的 er 通常发相同的音。
questions.explanation: sister 的词尾 er 通常发 /ə/ 音，与 teacher 的词尾 er 发音相同。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: 人教版 PEP 英语四年级下册
questions.knowledge: 学校场所词汇认读与拼写
questions.stem: 'art room' 是美术教室的意思。
questions.explanation: art是美术，room是房间，合起来是美术教室。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: 人教版 PEP 英语四年级下册
questions.stem: 如果要表示一楼，可以说 'one floor'。
questions.explanation: 应该用序数词 first floor。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: 人教版 PEP 英语四年级下册
questions.knowledge: 字母组合er在词尾的发音规则
questions.stem: 单词 dinner 结尾处的 er 发音与 water 结尾相同。
questions.explanation: 两者都符合词尾er发弱读/ə/的规律。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: 人教版 PEP 英语四年级下册
questions.knowledge: 确认场所的一般疑问句
questions.stem: Is this a teacher's desk? 它的回答可以是 Yes, it is.
questions.explanation: 一般疑问句Is this的常用肯定回答。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: 人教版 PEP 英语四年级下册
questions.stem: 句子 'The gym is next to the library.' 的意思是体育馆在图书馆后边。
questions.explanation: next to 的意思是'在...隔壁'或'紧邻'，不是'在...后边'。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: 人教版 PEP 英语四年级下册
questions.knowledge: 学校场所词汇认读与拼写
questions.stem: We have a new ________. We can draw pictures there.
questions.explanation: 美术教室是画画的地方。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: 人教版 PEP 英语四年级下册
questions.stem: Where is the ________ office?
questions.explanation: 教师办公室是指多位老师共用的，复数名词所有格在s后面加逗号。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: 人教版 PEP 英语四年级下册
questions.stem: —Is this the library? —No, it isn't. The library is ________ the second floor.
questions.explanation: 表示在楼层上，介词用on。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: 人教版 PEP 英语四年级下册
questions.knowledge: 确认场所的一般疑问句
questions.stem: —________ you have a music room? —Yes, we do.
questions.explanation: have是实义动词，主语you，疑问句需借助助动词do。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: 人教版 PEP 英语四年级下册
questions.knowledge: 学校场所词汇认读与拼写
questions.stem: Go to the ________. Play football.
questions.explanation: 在操场踢足球。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: 人教版 PEP 英语四年级下册
questions.knowledge: 确认场所的一般疑问句
questions.stem: That ________ the computer room.
questions.explanation: 主语that是单数，系动词用is。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: 人教版 PEP 英语四年级下册
questions.knowledge: 确认场所的一般疑问句
questions.stem: —Is that the teachers' office? —________. It's the library.
questions.explanation: 后文说它是图书馆，说明前面的回答是否定的。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: 人教版 PEP 英语四年级下册
questions.knowledge: 学校场所词汇认读与拼写
questions.stem: I like books. Let's go to the ________.
questions.explanation: 喜欢书的人通常去图书馆。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: 人教版 PEP 英语四年级下册
questions.stem: The computer room is ________ to the music room.
questions.explanation: next to 是固定词组。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: 人教版 PEP 英语四年级下册
questions.stem: —Where is your classroom? —It's on the ________ floor.
questions.explanation: 题目中已有the，所以只需填入序数词second。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 4 Semester 2
questions.stem: breakfast 的意思是“晚餐”。
questions.explanation: breakfast 意为“早餐”，dinner 才是“晚餐”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 4 Semester 2
questions.stem: 当你想问别人“几点了？”可以说：What time is it?
questions.explanation: “What time is it?”是询问现在几点钟的常用句型。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 4 Semester 2
questions.stem: go to school 的意思是“去上学”。
questions.explanation: go to school 是常用搭配，意思是“去上学”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 4 Semester 2
questions.knowledge: It's time for与It's time to句型区分
questions.stem: It's time for breakfast. 里的 breakfast 是动词短语。
questions.explanation: breakfast 是名词，所以用 It's time for breakfast。动词短语前才用 It's time to。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 4 Semester 2
questions.stem: o'clock 通常用在表示整点的数字之后。
questions.explanation: o’clock 意为“……点钟”，用于表示整点，如 six o’clock。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 4 Semester 2
questions.stem: It's seven ____.
questions.explanation: 表达整点时，可以在数字后加o'clock，如“It's seven o'clock.”

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 4 Semester 2
questions.knowledge: It's time for与It's time to句型区分
questions.stem: It's 9:00 p.m. It's time ____ go to bed.
questions.explanation: go 是动词原形，It's time to 后面接动词原形。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 4 Semester 2
questions.stem: I have ____ at 7:00 a.m.
questions.explanation: 早上七点通常是吃早餐的时间。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 4 Semester 2
questions.stem: —What time is it? —____
questions.explanation: 回答“What time is it?”时，要说出具体的时间。“It's 8:00.”表示现在是八点。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 4 Semester 2
questions.knowledge: It's time for与It's time to句型区分
questions.stem: It's time ____ PE class.
questions.explanation: PE class 是名词短语，It's time for 后面接名词或名词短语。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 4 Semester 2
questions.stem: Time ____ go to school.
questions.explanation: Time to + 动词是常用表达，完整句子可以说 It's time to go to school.

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 4 Semester 2
questions.stem: Let's drink some milk. It's time for ____.
questions.explanation: 喝牛奶可以是早餐时的活动；在给出的选项中，breakfast 最合适。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 4 Semester 2
questions.stem: School is over. Let's ____.
questions.explanation: “School is over.”表示放学了，接下来可以说“Let's go home.”，意思是“我们回家吧”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 4 Semester 2
questions.knowledge: It's time for与It's time to句型区分
questions.stem: Wait! It's time ____ dinner. Just a minute.
questions.explanation: dinner 是名词，表示晚餐，因此用 It's time for dinner。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 4 Semester 2
questions.stem: I __ up at 6:30.
questions.explanation: get up 是固定搭配，意为“起床”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 4 Semester 2
questions.stem: 单词 dinner 的意思是什么？
questions.explanation: dinner 的意思是“晚餐”，不是“早餐”或“午餐”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 4 Semester 2
questions.stem: 英语短语“get up”是什么意思？
questions.explanation: “get up”表示“起床”，所以正确答案是 B。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 4 Semester 2
questions.knowledge: It's time for与It's time to句型区分
questions.stem: 选择正确的句子，表示“该上学了”
questions.explanation: school 是名词，前面用 for。完整句子是 “It's time for school.”，意思是“该上学了”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 4 Semester 2
questions.stem: “6点整”可以表达为 six o'clock。
questions.explanation: 整点用法正确。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 4 Semester 2
questions.stem: get up 的意思是“去上学”。
questions.explanation: get up 是“起床”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 4 Semester 2
questions.knowledge: It's time for与It's time to句型区分
questions.stem: It's time for music class. (这里可以说 It's time to music class)
questions.explanation: music class 是名词，不能用 to。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 4 Semester 2
questions.knowledge: It's time for与It's time to句型区分
questions.stem: Time to go home. 这是 It's time to go home. 的简写形式。
questions.explanation: 口语中常省略 IT is。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 4 Semester 2
questions.stem: English class 之后要加 s 变成复数才正确。
questions.explanation: 泛指一节英语课时用单数。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 4 Semester 2
questions.explanation: 根据答句可知是问时间。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 4 Semester 2
questions.knowledge: It's time for与It's time to句型区分
questions.stem: It's 4:00. It's time to ____.
questions.explanation: to 后面接动词短语 go home。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 4 Semester 2
questions.stem: It's 7:00. It's time for ____.
questions.explanation: for 后面接名词 English。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 4 Semester 2
questions.stem: —What time is it now? —It's nine ____.
questions.explanation: 表示整点点钟。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 4 Semester 2
questions.stem: School is over. Let's go to the ____.
questions.explanation: 放学后通常可以去操场玩耍。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 4 Semester 2
questions.knowledge: It's time for与It's time to句型区分
questions.stem: It's time ____ breakfast.
questions.explanation: breakfast 是名词。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 4 Semester 2
questions.stem: Let's ____! It's 6:30. Time for school.
questions.explanation: hurry up 意为“快点”，符合语境。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 4 Semester 2
questions.explanation: Is it 开头的一般疑问句，肯定回答用 Yes, it is.

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 4 Semester 2
questions.knowledge: It's time for与It's time to句型区分
questions.stem: It's 7 p.m. It's time ____ dinner.
questions.explanation: It's time to have dinner 相当于 It's time for dinner。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP Primary English Grade 4 Semester 2
questions.explanation: 晚上九点是睡觉时间。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 4 Semester 2
questions.stem: 'sunny' 的意思是“晴朗的”。
questions.explanation: sunny 意为“晴朗的”，常用来描述阳光明媚的天气。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 4 Semester 2
questions.stem: 'rainy' 的意思是“下雪的”。
questions.explanation: rainy 意为“下雨的”；snowy 才表示“下雪的”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 4 Semester 2
questions.stem: 当天气 'hot' 时，我们适合穿 'sweater'。
questions.explanation: hot 表示天气炎热，通常不适合穿保暖的毛衣。Sweater 是“毛衣”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 4 Semester 2
questions.stem: 'cloudy' 对应的天气现象是“多云”。
questions.explanation: cloud 是“云”，cloudy 是“多云的”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 4 Semester 2
questions.stem: 询问天气可以用“What is the weather like?”
questions.explanation: “What is the weather like?”是询问天气情况的常用表达。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 4 Semester 2
questions.stem: It's very ____. Put on your coat.
questions.explanation: “穿上外套”提示天气很冷，cold 意为“寒冷的”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 4 Semester 2
questions.stem: Can I go outside? No, it's ____.（下雨的）
questions.explanation: 括号里的“下雨的”对应 rainy。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 4 Semester 2
questions.stem: ____ the weather like in New York?
questions.explanation: 询问天气可以说“What’s the weather like in New York?”，也可以说“How’s the weather in New York?”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 4 Semester 2
questions.stem: Look! It's ____. Let's make a snowman.
questions.explanation: snowy 意为“下雪的”，下雪时可以堆雪人。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 4 Semester 2
questions.stem: It's 26 degrees. It's ____.
questions.explanation: 26 degrees 通常表示天气温暖，可用 warm 描述。cold 是寒冷的，cool 是凉爽的，snowy 是下雪的。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 4 Semester 2
questions.stem: The sun is out. It's ____ today.
questions.explanation: 太阳出来了，天气通常是晴朗的；sunny 意为“晴朗的”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 4 Semester 2
questions.stem: Can I go outside? ____, you can.
questions.explanation: 肯定回答用“Yes, you can.”，句意是“可以，你能去”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 4 Semester 2
questions.stem: It's cool and ____. Let's fly a kite.
questions.explanation: 放风筝通常需要有风。句子说天气凉爽并邀请大家去放风筝，因此 windy（有风的）最符合情境。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 4 Semester 2
questions.stem: What's the weather like ____ Beijing?
questions.explanation: 表示在某个城市里，通常用 in，所以说 in Beijing。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 4 Semester 2
questions.stem: Time to go to bed. ____!
questions.explanation: 睡觉前说晚安用 Good night。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 4 Semester 2
questions.stem: “windy”是什么意思？
questions.explanation: windy 的意思是“有风的”，不是单独的“风”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 4 Semester 2
questions.stem: rainy 的意思是“下雨的”。
questions.explanation: rainy 表示“下雨的”，可用于描述正在下雨或常有雨的天气。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 4 Semester 2
questions.stem: “What’s the weather like?”可以用来询问天气。
questions.explanation: “What’s the weather like?”也可以用来询问天气状况。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 4 Semester 2
questions.stem: It is rainy. You can fly a kite outside.
questions.explanation: 下雨时在室内读书更合适。fly a kite（放风筝）通常适合有风、天气较好的时候。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 4 Semester 2
questions.stem: It's very ____ outside. Please wear your coat.
questions.explanation: cold 表示寒冷。寒冷的天气适合穿外套保暖。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 4 Semester 2
questions.stem: When it's rainy, taking an umbrella is a good idea.
questions.explanation: 下雨时带雨伞是合适的选择。umbrella 的意思是“雨伞”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 4 Semester 2
questions.stem: “I am a student.”是正确的句子。
questions.explanation: 句子主语是“I”，对应的 be 动词是“am”，所以“I am a student.”正确。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 4 Semester 2
questions.stem: ____ the weather today?
questions.explanation: “How’s the weather?”是询问天气的常用表达，How’s是How is的缩写。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 4 Semester 2
questions.stem: How's the weather?（天气晴朗。）
questions.explanation: 回答天气情况时常用“It’s + 天气形容词”。sunny表示晴朗的。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 4 Semester 2
questions.stem: Can I borrow your ruler? — ____. Here you are.
questions.explanation: “Sure.”表示“当然可以”，是对请求许可的肯定回答。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 4 Semester 2
questions.stem: Can I watch TV now? — Sorry, you need to do your homework. — ____.
questions.explanation: 前句说明现在不能看电视，因此应回答“No, you can't.”，表示不允许。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 4 Semester 2
questions.stem: 判断正误：别人问“Can I open the window?”，回答“Yes, you can.”表示允许。
questions.explanation: “Yes, you can.”表示允许，是对“Can I ...?”的合适肯定回答。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 4 Semester 2
questions.stem: It's raining outside. Take your ____ with you.
questions.explanation: 下雨时带伞可以遮雨，所以 umbrella（雨伞）符合句意。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 4 Semester 2
questions.stem: It's lunchtime. I'm ____. Let's eat.
questions.explanation: 午饭时间到了，大家通常会感到饿，因此 hungry（饿的）最符合情境。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 4 Semester 2
questions.stem: We can't go to the park ____ it's raining.
questions.explanation: 后半句说明了不能去公园的原因，用 because（因为）连接原因和结果。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 4 Semester 2
questions.stem: It's cold today, so I will wear my coat.
questions.explanation: 句子说天冷，穿上外套可以保暖，前后意思合理。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 4 Semester 2
questions.stem: The book is ____ the desk.
questions.explanation: 书本在桌子的表面上，用 on。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 4 Semester 2
questions.stem: The cat is ____ the room.
questions.explanation: 表示人在房间里面，用 in。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 4 Semester 2
questions.stem: The children are ____ school now.
questions.explanation: at school 表示“在学校”，用于指明具体地点。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 4 Semester 2
questions.stem: The ball is ____ the chair.（球在椅子下面。）
questions.explanation: under 表示“在……下面”，球在椅子下面。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 4 Semester 2
questions.stem: The dog is ____ the door.（狗在门后面。）
questions.explanation: behind 表示“在……后面”，狗在门后面。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 4 Semester 2
questions.stem: It is 8:00 a.m. You meet your teacher. You say, “____!”
questions.explanation: 上午见面时通常说 Good morning，表示“早上好”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 4 Semester 2
questions.stem: It is 3:00 p.m. You see your friend. You say, “____!”
questions.explanation: 下午见面时可以说 Good afternoon，表示“下午好”。

questions.subject: 英语
questions.edition: PEP English Grade 4 Semester 2
questions.stem: You are leaving your friend. What can you say?
questions.explanation: Bye 是常见的“再见”，朋友分别时可以使用。
